Concurrent test-time methods give a frozen policy such an input from retrieved successes, a learned critic, a verifier, or a dynamics model, but none uses the robot's own failed rollouts as negative evidence with nothing but a terminal outcome bit. We introduce TraceFlow, a progress-aligned guidance field that turns the action densities of retrieved successful and failed rollouts into a bounded correction to a frozen flow-matching action expert, using one terminal outcome bit per rollout and no other label. Its TraceBank stores traces, time-ordered state-action records with a terminal label, starts from the target-task training traces, and later admits the deployed robot's own rollouts. On an ordered real-robot packing task the base completes 21 of 50 trials in order, TraceFlow 39, and one stacking round without any weight update 47, with wrong-sequence episodes falling from 20 to 0. In simulation the gain is selective: with per-suite selected settings, TraceFlow raises RoboMemArena Sequence from 78.92\% to 91.50\% task success and Transferring from 54.41\% to 62.00\% at stacking round 2, leaves the 26-task aggregate unchanged, lowers Counting and Occlusion by 1.12 and 1.42 points, and changes LIBERO-Plus (Long) by +1.27 points (p = 0.0733). Stacking gains are finite, every branch peaking before round ten, and the bank's success-to-failure ratio predicts no retrieval allocation.

</details>


### [278] [SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20648)
*Kaivalya Agrawal,Md Ashiqur Rahman,Raymond A. Yeh,Zachary Kingston*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkipVLA提出一种混合策略，将预训练VLA与经典运动规划器结合：规划器负责自由空间运动，VLA仅在抓取、放置等接触密集技能时被查询，从而显著降低时延与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽能将图像与语言指令直接映射为机器人动作，但推理时速度慢，尤其在需要多次查询的长时程任务中。现有加速方法（蒸馏小模型、异步动作块重叠、搭配快速底层策略）仍需让学习策略贯穿整个任务执行过程。相比之下，经典运动规划器能快速求解无碰撞运动，但缺乏语义理解且需要显式目标，二者各有明显局限。

Method: SkipVLA将预训练VLA与经典运动规划器组合：由规划器完成自由空间运动，仅在抓取、放置等接触密集技能上查询VLA。该方法复用VLA中冻结的视觉-语言主干来预测每次规划运动的目标位姿，并借助大VLA已学到的知识训练该预测器，无需在系统中额外引入示范数据。

Result: 在仿真环境的13个LIBERO任务上使用三种VLA进行评测，并在物理6-DoF YAM机械臂上完成三项抓取-放置任务。结果显示，任务完成速度最高提升2.5倍，能耗显著降低，同时保持相同的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 将学习型VLA策略与经典运动规划相结合，可在不牺牲成功率的前提下提升长时程机器人任务的执行效率，为降低VLA部署的时延与能耗提供了一条有效途径。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

</details>


### [279] [HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20659)
*Zimu Han,Yiming Zeng,Jiyao Zhang,Zihao Zhao,Yuanfei Wang,Yixiang Jin,Shiqi Li,Shuangben Chen,Wei Huang,Ruodai Li,Hui Shen,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HIL-UMI，一种无需真实机器人执行、基于手持 UMI 采集的人机在环 VLA 后训练框架，通过 Energy Score 触发分布外数据采集，并用优势估计器引导优势条件行为克隆，在四项真实任务上稳定优于 SFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽提供强大操作先验，但适配具体部署仍困难。任务级示教的监督微调（SFT）存在两点局限：静态数据对分布外状态覆盖不足；标准模仿目标无法区分"有进展"与"低价值"数据。现有交互式后训练虽可缓解，却通常需要在物理机器人上反复执行策略并依赖人工干预，成本与部署门槛高。

Method: HIL-UMI 采用策略引导的通用操作接口（UMI）框架，实现免机器人的人机在环 VLA 后训练。在手持 UMI 示教过程中，将当前策略在同一观测流上查询但不执行其预测动作；Energy Score 比较人类动作轨迹与策略推理结果，当二者差异指示分布外区域时触发数据采集。另一条反馈回路中，低在线优势预测用于定位关键片段，以精炼基于进展的优势估计器；更新后的估计器再以基础示教与新策略数据的平衡混合，指导优势条件行为克隆（advantage-conditioned BC）。该设计保留人机在环学习的迭代性与策略感知特性，同时将数据采集与机器人部署解耦。

Result: 在四个跨长程与精细操作的真实任务上，HIL-UMI 相较 SFT 取得一致提升，并从定向采集与优势精炼中获益。在 Clean Up Table 任务上，HIL-UMI 优于 HG-DAgger，且单帧采集时间更低，表明其具备跨操作者与地点规模化 VLA 后训练的潜力。

Conclusion: HIL-UMI 将人机在环 VLA 后训练从物理机器人执行中解耦，借助手持 UMI 采集、Energy Score 触发与优势条件行为克隆，在真实任务上稳定超越 SFT 与 HG-DAgger，为可扩展的 VLA 部署后训练提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

</details>


### [280] [MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20670)
*Haozhe Lei,Ruibin Chen,Yuhan Jiang,Ali Rasteh,Aditya Dhananjay,Sundeep Rangan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MAGNETAR 通过单个异步射频多径快照，在已知房间布局与接收机位姿的条件下，从 AoA 和 SNR 估计中推断发射机平面位置与朝向的联合后验分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在杂乱房间中，单次测量常与多个发射机位置一致；且由于上中频段天线具有方向性，还可能对应多个朝向。因此仅给出点估计不足以支撑机器人对无线电发射机的定位，需要能够表达多模态不确定性的联合后验。

Method: 提出 MAGNETAR：在离散化的位置-朝向网格上，用五种神经评分器联合归一化得分；最终采用以候选朝向为条件、参数共享的 2D U-Net，输出位置与朝向的联合后验。训练使用经真机到仿真校准的 10 GHz 仿真数据及少量实测子集。

Result: 在留出仿真上，基于网格的联合后验优于参数化后验；以朝向为条件的评分器在机器人实测数据上的迁移效果最佳；融合联合后验优于融合仅位置的边缘后验。

Conclusion: MAGNETAR 表明，将位置与朝向作为联合变量、并以朝向为条件进行评分与网格归一化，能更有效地表达和利用射频多径中的多模态信息，提升机器人射频定位的鲁棒性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

</details>


### [281] [Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20691)
*Andrea Capuozzo,Fabio Ruggiero,Vincenzo Lippiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文为跨介质（空中-水面）无人机提出一种PX4固件扩展，将手动与自主水面航行模式集成进标准PX4任务管线与QGroundControl界面，在保留飞行功能与安全机制的同时支持含空中与水面航点的统一规划与执行，并通过仿真验证了平静与波浪条件下水面航行的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水环境测绘与监测需求促使跨介质无人机在同一任务中结合飞行与水面航行能力；然而现有PX4等开源飞控固件仅面向空中飞行，缺乏对水面航行模式及混合航点任务的支持，难以实现统一的规划与执行。

Method: 在PX4固件层面进行扩展：新增手动与自主水面航行模式，将其接入标准PX4任务管线（mission pipeline）与QGroundControl地面站界面，并定义可区分的空中航点与水面航点，实现混合任务的统一规划与执行；同时保持原有飞行功能与安全机制不变。

Result: 通过仿真案例验证了实现的有效性，并表明该平台在平静水面与波浪条件下均能实现稳定的水面航行。

Conclusion: 该PX4固件扩展为跨介质空中-水面无人机提供了可行的统一任务规划与执行框架，能够在兼容既有飞行功能与安全机制的前提下实现稳定的水面导航，为水环境测绘与监测等混合任务奠定基础。

Abstract: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

</details>


### [282] [HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20694)
*Pranay Meshram,Charuvahan Adhivarahan,Prithvi Poddar,Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani,Chen Wang,Souma Chowdhury,Karthik Dantu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 HOPHY——一种基于超图的分层越野规划框架，将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通语义节点、保连通性的粗区域和带类型的超边，支持在环境变化时局部更新而不重建整个层级结构，实现像素级规划精度与显著更低的查询/重规划延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害响应、搜救和战术无人地面车辆（UGV）任务级自主需要在态势、智能体类型和目标反复变化时进行重复路径与任务规划。像素网格搜索在公里级重复查询中代价高昂，而语义抽象方法必须在地形条件变化时仍保持有效的代价与连通性，现有方法难以兼顾效率与保真度。

Method: HOPHY 构建可复用的分层地形表示：1）几何连通语义区域（GSNodes）；2）保持连通性的关键区域（Coarse Regions）；3）用于编码地形、智能体和天气上下文的带类型超边。超边相交用于选取受影响区域及其关联边进行状态更新，无需重建层级。将该表示应用于多机器人任务分配（MRTA）问题，并在物理 Clearpath Jackal 平台上进行实地验证。

Result: 在覆盖公里级区域的真实越野地图上，HOPHY 达到 100% 规划成功率，与 oracle（像素 A*）的中位代价偏差小于 0.01%，查询与重规划延迟显著低于所评测的像素及抽象基线。在 MRTA 任务中，总计算量较像素 A* 降低 79 倍，较最快的抽象基线降低 7.2 倍，任务完工时间（makespan）与像素 A* 相当。物理 Jackal 平台成功完成 1.5 公里、八任务的混合地表户外任务，并实现阻塞触发的重规划路径。

Conclusion: HOPHY 通过超图结构化的分层地形表示与局部超边相交更新机制，在保持与像素级规划近似等价代价精度的同时大幅提升重复查询与重规划效率，验证了其在真实越野多机器人任务级自主中的实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

</details>


### [283] [MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20709)
*Jiayu Wang,Bin Zhu,Yue Yu,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MoWAM 提出用显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，在推理阶段完全去除视频生成，保留显式未来表示，实现高效且鲁棒的机器人策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models 通过引入未来动态提升策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频带来巨大计算开销；若移除未来生成虽提升效率，却使未来动态仅隐式编码于观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。

Method: MoWAM 将完整未来场景重建替换为结构化机器人运动的显式预测，把运动作为未来的紧凑抽象，刻画当前场景与交互约束下机器人的预期演化；采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构在训练中学习未来视觉动态并联合预测运动与动作，使推理时可完全移除视频生成；同时利用紧凑运动表示进行推理时扩展，采样多组运动-动作候选，并用运动感知任务进度验证器进行选择。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM 取得强分布内性能、更优的分布外鲁棒性，以及高于代表性 WAM 基线的真实世界平均成功率；随着候选数量增加，性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 显式未来运动为推理时扩展提供了有效且高效的基础，可在不生成未来视频的前提下兼顾效率、鲁棒性与性能。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [284] [Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20731)
*Yuheng Zhou,Haiyang Cheng,Yanqi Feng,Pangkit Fong,Mei Xuan Lee,Marcus Gee,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 面向AUV的水下视觉目标跟踪受深度测量不可靠与目标运动未知困扰，本文提出立体视觉伺服框架：感知端通过目标深度提取与卡尔曼滤波获得稳定3D相对状态，控制端将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，实现实时平移MPC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的水下目标跟踪面临两大挑战：深度测量不可靠、目标运动模式未知。现有框架难以同时保证状态估计的稳定性与控制的实时性，且耦合多自由度优化计算开销大。

Method: 感知方面：由颜色、视差与时间线索构建目标深度掩膜以筛选可靠目标像素，分别对深度测量与检测图像中心进行滤波，从而从立体图像中提取稳定的3D相对状态。控制方面：将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免计算昂贵的耦合多自由度优化；平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合恒速与零速目标模型，利用历史预测误差更新模型权重，并在执行器、跟踪距离与视场约束下求解平移指令。

Result: 通过仿真与真实实验验证了框架的有效性，并表明其性能优于现有框架。

Conclusion: 该立体视觉伺服框架通过可靠性筛选的深度估计与解耦的自适应模型融合MPC，在保证实时性的同时提升了对未知运动目标的水下跟踪性能。

Abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

</details>


### [285] [MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20747)
*Thomas Steinecker,Denis Trescher,Alexander Bienemann,Thorsten Luettel,Mirko Maehlisch*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MILER，一种面向非结构化环境的端到端自动驾驶策略框架，通过中层级语义表征实现感知与控制的零样本sim-to-real迁移，在真实车辆上完成17.3 km无干预自主驾驶。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习具备超越人类表现与自学习策略的潜力，但在真实世界自动驾驶中应用稀少，尤其是非结构化环境，核心障碍在于此类环境下的sim-to-real迁移困难。

Method: 离线训练阶段，采用定制的中层级语义表征（MLR）仿真器，用强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型；真实部署阶段，用BEVFusion处理相机与LiDAR数据，生成与MLR仿真器一致的语义鸟瞰图表征；策略网络输出的动作不直接作用于实车，而是通过轨迹对齐策略实现感知与控制的零样本迁移。整个软件栈运行于Jetson AGX Orin。

Result: 在包含多种障碍、发卡弯、最高33.6 km/h速度及越野路段的多样化测试赛道上评估，使用两辆不同车辆在3.0 km测试赛道上共行驶17.3 km，全程无人工干预。

Conclusion: MILER验证了基于中层级语义表征与轨迹对齐策略的零样本sim-to-real迁移方案在非结构化环境自动驾驶中的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

</details>


### [286] [Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20761)
*Hanchu Zhou,Brendan Lynch,Raman Goyal,Dechen Gao,Begum Kasap,Boqi Zhao,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 \ABBR{}，一种面向接触丰富机器人控制的敏捷触觉世界动作模型。它通过共享潜在空间实现视觉-触觉到动作的流匹配，并采用多时间尺度多模态预测，在仿真实与真实任务上兼顾成功率与低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型（tactile WAMs）多依赖大规模预训练生成式骨干网络来建模接触物理动力学，导致推理效率低、部署灵活性差。作者希望在不牺牲接触动力学建模能力的前提下，构建一个高效、可灵活部署的触觉 WAM。

Method: 提出 \ABBR{}：将视觉与触觉观测编码为共享潜在表示，并以此为源进行直接的视觉-触觉到动作流匹配，联合生成动作块潜在表示与未来视觉/触觉潜在表示。基于视觉帧间高度相似而触觉信号在接触时突变的时间尺度差异，引入多时间尺度多模态预测：对视觉潜在采用较大时间偏移监督，对触觉潜在预测下一帧以捕捉细粒度接触动力学。

Result: 在 9 个仿真与 5 个真实世界接触丰富操作任务上，\ABBR{} 表现强劲且鲁棒，成功率超过最强基线并保持低推理延迟。5 个真实实验中，整体成功率相对提升 29.4%，推理延迟为 11.9 ms。

Conclusion: 结果表明，多模态世界动作模型可通过敏捷架构实现，适用于精确且高频率的机器人控制，无需依赖笨重的生成式骨干网络。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

</details>


### [287] [GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20776)
*Xin Chen,Sen Chen,Yujuan Ding,Jian Liu,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Heng Tao Shen,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 GeoAAC——一种基于几何信息的自适应动作分块方法，利用 Flow Matching 去噪轨迹的几何特征动态确定动作视界，无需额外训练即可提升 VLA 策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略多采用固定的动作视界（action horizon），但同一 rollout 中不同任务阶段对动作连续性、控制精度和闭环反馈的需求各不相同，固定视界难以适应变化的控制需求。

Method: 发现 Flow Matching 去噪轨迹的几何特征可提供过程级信息来刻画预测可靠性，且动作前缀间的几何变化与预测不确定性正相关。据此构建前缀级几何，形成视界级几何剖面，在单次生成中自适应确定动作视界，无需额外训练。

Result: 在 GR00T N1.5 与 π0.5 上，于 LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365 及真实操作任务中，一致优于固定视界基线及现有自适应方法：仿真最高提升 8.7 个百分点，真实世界平均成功率从 53.3% 提升至 74.4%。

Conclusion: 动作视界可依据生成过程中的几何可靠性信号自适应调整，GeoAAC 以低成本、免训练的方式显著改善 VLA 策略在仿真与真实任务中的表现。

Abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

</details>


### [288] [StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20791)
*Jinbang Huang,Yuanzhao Hu,Zhiyuan Li,Ran Qi,Yixin Xiao,Yangzheng Wu,Tengyue Ba,Zhanguang Zhang,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 StageGuard 智能体蒸馏框架，利用教师模型推理与演示轨迹生成结构化解释，训练轻量学生 VLM 产生紧凑自解释，用于分层机器人控制中的阶段转换（技能终止）判断，实现准确且高效的在线监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层规划框架需判断何时终止当前技能并进入下一子任务，但现有方法依赖难以获取的预设计完成信号检查器；大规模 VLM 虽具推理能力，但其决策边界与任务完成标准不一致，且云端部署与长推理带来显著延迟，难以实时监控。

Method: StageGuard：智能体蒸馏框架。结合教师模型推理与演示轨迹，生成关于子任务完成与策略切换的结构化解释；据此让轻量学生 VLM 生成紧凑的自解释，并用于监督微调。

Result: 在两个基准的轨迹上评估阶段转换预测，并通过集成到 BEHAVIOR-1K 的分层机器人控制中评估闭环任务成功率，另在真实机器人上进一步验证。结果显示阶段转换预测显著提升，同时支持高效的在线监控。

Conclusion: StageGuard 通过蒸馏方式将教师推理对齐到任务完成标准并由轻量学生模型承载，在准确性与效率间取得平衡，为分层机器人长时程任务执行提供可行的实时阶段转换监控方案。

Abstract: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.

</details>


### [289] [Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20820)
*Nitish Dashora,Douglas Chen,Idan Shenfeld,John Marangola,Pulkit Agrawal,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"workspace token"——一种在训练期用VLM蒸馏得到的轻量级潜在记忆表示，部署时可替代观测直接供策略使用，无需在环VLM推理，能解决记忆密集型操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂机器人操作任务常需对历史事件与动作的长期记忆。直接以完整历史为条件会导致策略产生伪相关并降低性能，因此现有方法多在部署时通过在环调用昂贵的VLM查询来压缩历史信息，仅保留任务显著信息，代价高昂。

Method: 将计算密集的VLM查询移至训练阶段：先用VLM识别完成当前任务所必需的当前与历史信息，再通过集合重建解码器损失（set-reconstruction decoder loss）将这些信息蒸馏进一个轻量级潜在记忆——workspace token。部署时该token可直接查询，作为观测的即插即用替代，无需在环VLM推理。

Result: 在仿真与真实硬件上验证，workspace token可在部署时替代观测，使策略无需在环VLM推理即可求解记忆密集型任务。此外发现workspace token不仅更轻量，还带来更好的策略性能。

Conclusion: 通过将VLM重计算前移到训练阶段并蒸馏为紧凑潜在记忆，可在部署阶段实现高效且性能更优的记忆条件策略，为机器人长时程操作提供了一种替代在环VLM查询的可行方案。

Abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [290] [Position Paper: Neurotransmitters as a Missing Dimension in Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20083)
*Yupei Li,Manuel Milling,Berrak Sisman,Björn Schuller*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张将神经调质机制作为学习"第三轴"显式建模进人工神经网络，以弥补传统网络自适应性不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工神经网络作为现代深度学习系统的核心，缺乏生物系统所具有的适应灵活性与长期稳定性。其根源在于传统ANN依赖统一的、局部的、基于梯度的参数更新，忽视了神经递质信号与神经可塑性等内部学习原理。现有方法多从架构扩展或正则化、参数隔离等数学微调入手，未能触及这一生物机制层面的缺口。

Method: 受哺乳动物大脑优越适应性与可塑性启发，本文以立场论文（positional paper）形式提出：神经调质所介导的调控构成学习的第三轴，与神经活动、突触可塑性并列，应在ANN中被显式建模。文章通过论证性阐述为这一研究范式提供论据与方向。

Result: 作为立场性工作，本文未提供实验或定量结果，其主要产出为概念框架：确立"神经活动—突触可塑性—神经调质调控"三轴学习观，并指出现有ANN设计普遍缺失第三轴这一维度。

Conclusion: 作者认为，将神经调质原理纳入ANN设计是一条富有前景却研究不足的方向，呼吁在自适应与持续学习系统的开发中给予该视角更多关注。

Abstract: Artificial neural networks (ANNs), as core components of modern deep learning (DL) systems, lack the adaptive flexibility and long-term stability exhibited by biological systems. This limitation largely stems from the fact that conventional ANNs rely on uniform, local, and gradient-based parameter updates, while neglecting internal learning principles that are biological mechanisms such as neurotransmitters signalling or neuroplasticity. Consequently, many existing approaches focus on architectural expansion or mathematical fine-tuning techniques such as regularisation or parameter isolation. Inspired by the superior adaptability and plasticity of mammalian brains, we posit that neuromodulation with neurotransmitters constitutes a third axis of learning, complementary to neural activity and synaptic plasticity, and should be explicitly modelled in artificial neural networks. In this positional paper, we argue that incorporating neuromodulatory principles into ANN design represents a promising and underexplored research direction, and we advocate for greater attention to this perspective in the development of adaptive and continual learning systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [291] [Algebraic Retrieval: Composable Search for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19482)
*Damian Delmas*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出"代数检索"（Algebraic Retrieval），允许AI代理在查询时用数学查询组合检索策略；基于PEM实现对比评分、候选池重排、加权排序等可组合查询，并在Vaswani数据集上验证执行一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使AI代理能在查询时组合搜索策略，将相关性准则、资格约束与排序偏好统一表达为数学查询；查询接口暴露可用操作，便于代理针对具体问题组合操作并在查看结果后修改程序。研究关注执行一致性（execution parity），而非代理行为或检索质量。

Method: 在Programmatic Embedding Modulation（PEM）基础上，暴露检索过程中的向量与分数算术；将对比评分、候选池重排、加权排序作为可组合查询实现，并提供可执行的SQL与PyTerrier对应实现。

Result: 在公开的11,429文档Vaswani测试集上，各程序的实现选出相同的文档集合，分数差异低于1e-6；仅有一对并列文档在不同评分路径下排序不同。

Conclusion: 代数检索通过暴露可组合的向量与分数算术操作，实现了跨实现（原生、SQL、PyTerrier）的执行一致性，验证了查询组合策略在数值层面的一致性，并揭示并列排序在评分路径间的细微差异。

Abstract: Algebraic Retrieval lets AI agents compose search strategies at query time. Relevance criteria, eligibility constraints, and ranking preferences can be expressed together in a mathematical query. The query surface exposes available operations, so an agent can combine them for the question at hand and revise a program after inspecting results. We evaluate execution parity, not agent behavior or retrieval quality. Building on Programmatic Embedding Modulation (PEM), which exposes vector and score arithmetic during retrieval, we demonstrate contrastive scoring, candidate-pool reranking, and weighted ranking as composable queries, alongside executable SQL and PyTerrier counterparts. On the public 11,429-document Vaswani fixture, each program's implementations select the same document set with score differences below 1e-6; one tied pair orders differently across scoring paths.

</details>


### [292] [Beyond Similarity through Zero-Token Geometric Graphs for Multi-Hop RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19622)
*Zeliang Li,Xiaofen Xing,Kailing Guo,Xiangmin Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出G³RAG：一种无需LLM、仅基于文档表征几何关系构建图的RAG框架，通过几何增益评分与密度感知拓扑惩罚实现高效多跳检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳RAG需要既与查询相关又能提供足够新颖性以跨越语义鸿沟的证据。稠密检索倾向于聚集语义相似文档，难以跨语义鸿沟；图方法多依赖昂贵的LLM实体抽取，且易沿噪声连接传播。

Method: G³RAG为文档级框架，离线图构建不使用LLM调用或生成token。为每条边赋予几何增益分数cosθ·sinθ，同时刻画文档表征间的方向一致性与正交性；引入密度感知拓扑惩罚抑制高度连接的hub节点；从过滤后的查询种子出发进行单步受控扩散，扩展至互补证据。

Result: 在MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA上，使用Nv-embed-v2与Qwen3-8B-embed两种嵌入，G³RAG在图基基线中取得最佳平均F1与答案文档命中率；平均性能提升最高达4.26个F1点，MusiQue上提升5.76点；同时消除了实体型图方法的图构建token开销。

Conclusion: 几何结构可在不依赖LLM图构建的情况下支持高效的多跳证据发现。

Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires evidence that remains relevant to a query while introducing enough novelty to bridge semantic gaps. Dense retrieval tends to concentrate on semantically similar documents, whereas graph-based alternatives often depend on costly Large Language Model (LLM) entity extraction and may propagate through noisy connections. We introduce Geometric Gain Graph RAG (G$^3$RAG), a document-only framework whose offline graph construction uses no LLM calls or generated tokens. G$^3$RAG assigns each edge a geometric gain score, $\cosθ\cdot \sinθ$, that jointly captures directional consistency and orthogonality between document representations. A density-aware topological penalty suppresses highly connected hubs, while single-step controlled diffusion expands from filtered query seeds toward complementary evidence. We evaluate G$^3$RAG on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA using Nv-embed-v2 and Qwen3-8B-embed. G$^3$RAG obtains the best average F1 and answer-document hit rate among the evaluated graph-based baselines in both embedding settings, with gains of up to 4.26 F1 points in average performance and 5.76 points on MusiQue. It also removes the graph-construction token cost incurred by entity-based graph methods. These results show that geometric structure can support efficient multi-hop evidence discovery without LLM-based graph construction. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/G3RAG-99D9/

</details>


### [293] [Self-Evolving Search Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19656)
*Sangam Lee,Wonjae Lee,Sunghwan Kim,Deogyong Kim,Jaehoon Kim,Daye Nam,SeongKu Kang,Dongha Lee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 SELF-INDEX 框架，使检索索引无需人工干预即可自演化：Optimizer 自动诊断检索缺陷、选择性修订索引键并验证后更新，Query Simulator 主动模拟额外需求，从而泛化到未见查询。多语料、多检索器上稳定提升检索性能，并改善搜索 agent 与 agent memory 的效果与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 需处理多样信息需求，检索质量高度依赖索引键对文档知识的表征效果。但有效表征随检索环境变化，固定优化策略难以稳定适用；而让索引适配环境目前主要靠人工诊断失败、调整策略、重处理索引，成本高且难扩展。

Method: 提出 SELF-INDEX 自演化索引框架。核心是 Optimizer：自主诊断检索不足、定位并选择性修订需负责的索引键，且每次修订先验证再更新索引；并引入 Query Simulator 主动探索额外检索需求，使索引优化超越现有可用查询，实现环境自适应。

Result: 在多种语料与检索器上，SELF-INDEX 一致提升检索性能，优于现有索引优化方法。收益还可迁移到下游应用：提升搜索 agent 的效果与效率，并帮助 agent memory 系统检索到有用的历史交互。

Conclusion: 索引可被设计为在无人工干预下随检索环境自演化，缓解固定优化策略的泛化难题；该机制不仅提升基础检索指标，还能增强 agent 检索与记忆等下游能力。

Abstract: Information retrieval is increasingly important as LLM agents tackle complex tasks involving diverse information needs. Because retrieval relies on an index that represents each document through index keys, retrieval quality depends heavily on how effectively these keys expose the knowledge contained in each document. However, effective index representations vary across retrieval environments, making it difficult for any fixed optimization strategy to perform consistently. Yet evolving an index to its retrieval environment remains largely human-driven, requiring humans to diagnose retrieval failures, refine the optimization strategy, and reprocess the index accordingly. We propose SELF-INDEX, a framework that enables an index to self-evolve without human intervention. Its Optimizer autonomously diagnoses retrieval shortfalls, selectively revises the responsible index keys, and validates each revision before updating the index. Beyond reacting to observed retrieval demands, SELF-INDEX proactively explores additional demands through a Query Simulator, allowing the index to evolve beyond the queries already available for optimization. Across diverse corpora and retrievers, SELF-INDEX consistently improves retrieval performance while outperforming existing index optimization methods. We further show that these benefits extend to downstream applications, improving the effectiveness and efficiency of search agents and helping agent memory systems retrieve useful past interactions.

</details>


### [294] [Dense Feature Representation over Sequence Modeling: A Solution to the KDD Cup 2026 UniRec Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19787)
*Yi Zhang,Weiliang Ji*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文报告KDD Cup 2026腾讯UniRec挑战赛第10名方案：在3482万条记录的工业CVR预测任务中，通过15步单变量链将测试AUC从0.813237提升至0.827816，最终提交0.828535；消融显示稠密特征表示与正交化优化器是主要增益来源，而序列建模组件贡献均在噪声带内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级CVR预测中，各类模型改进机制（表示、优化、序列建模）的真实贡献常被混淆；且共同时间窗口的行组划分会使验证AUC虚高，导致离线结论与排行榜不一致。作者旨在厘清在3482万记录规模下，究竟哪些机制真正提升留出AUC，并揭示验证集高估的泛化风险。

Method: 以官方PCVRHyFormer为基线，构建15步单变量改进链逐步替换组件；对完整模型做留一消融（leave-one-out）量化各组件贡献；并对比行组划分与时间重划分下的验证/排行榜表现，检验反记忆与高基数ID改动的影响。

Result: 单变量链使测试AUC由0.813237升至0.827816，最终提交达0.828535。消融显示：移除稠密特征表示栈损失0.0095 AUC，移除正交化优化器损失0.0028；而合并单流骨干、极性通道、辅助头、逐token FFN等序列建模组件损失均不超过0.0005，落在±0.0004种子波动带内。此外，行组划分验证AUC比排行榜高估约0.014，反记忆与高基数ID改动甚至出现符号反转，该分歧源于dump间分布漂移，且在时间重划分后依然存在。

Conclusion: 在该规模下，驱动CVR AUC的是稠密表示与优化，而非更精细的序列建模；离线验证存在系统性高估，可靠结论必须来自留出排行榜。

Abstract: We describe our 10th-place solution to the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, industrial click-to-conversion (CVR) prediction over 34.82M records, and we ask which mechanisms actually move held-out AUC. Starting from the official PCVRHyFormer baseline, a 15-step single-variable chain raises test AUC from 0.813237 to 0.827816, and our final submission reaches 0.828535. A leave-one-out ablation from the full model attributes the gain: removing the dense-feature representation stack costs 0.0095 AUC and removing the orthogonalized optimizer costs 0.0028, while no sequence-modeling component (merged single-stream backbone, polarity channel, auxiliary head, per-token FFN) costs more than 0.0005, within or adjacent to a $\pm$0.0004 seed band. We also report a generalization hazard: the row-group train/validation split shares one time window, so validation AUC overstates the leaderboard by about 0.014; anti-memorization and high-cardinality-ID changes even invert sign against it, a divergence that traces to dump-to-dump distribution shift and survives a time-ordered re-split. Dense representation and optimization, not finer sequence modeling, drive CVR AUC at this scale, and verdicts must come from the held-out leaderboard.

</details>


### [295] [Reproducing Transparent and Scrutable Recommendations: Exploring Open-Weight Models via Natural-Language User Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19831)
*Noah Mamié,Laurin van den Bergh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该复现研究验证了基于生成式自然语言用户画像的推荐系统的透明性与可审查性，成功复现原研究核心结论，并通过消融、多随机种子稳定性与机制可解释性分析发现：画像扰动虽改变预测评分，但呈跨类型均匀偏移，无类型选择性效应，排序不变，根源在于评分回归目标而非画像接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原研究提出通过生成式自然语言用户画像增强推荐系统，使推荐更透明并支持用户直接干预（纠正偏好误判、缓解冷启动）。本文动机在于对该主张进行可复现性检验，并进一步探究此类画像接口是否真正带来可审查性与可干预性，即扰动画像是否会选择性地改变推荐结果。

Method: 复现原研究：在Amazon Movies & TV、TripAdvisor等跨领域原始用户评论文本上合成自然语言用户画像。扩展评估包括：(1) 系统性上下文消融实验；(2) 使用五个不同随机种子的多种子稳定性实验以建立统计可靠性；(3) 基于nnsight框架的机制可解释性分析，通过反事实画像扰动探测模型内部表示；并采用直接激活引导（activation steering）检验排序变化。

Result: 成功复现原研究核心发现：User Profile Recommendation (UPR) 在其测试集重排协议下取得有竞争力性能，并使推荐更透明。但反事实画像扰动虽改变预测，却仅导致跨类型评分一致性偏移，未检测到类型选择性效应；即便施加直接激活引导，排序仍不变。该现象可归因于评分回归目标，而非画像界面本身；排序目标模型在该任务上表现明显更优。

Conclusion: UPR的可复现性与透明性主张成立，但其可干预性受限于评分回归目标：自然语言画像无法实现类型选择性的推荐调整。未来应转向排序目标建模范式，以真正释放画像接口的可审查与可干预潜力。

Abstract: In this reproducibility study, we investigate the transparency and scrutability of recommender systems enhanced by incorporating generated natural-language user profiles that represent user preferences. The original paper explores the synthesis of user profiles from raw user-generated review text across domains such as movies and accommodations (Amazon Movies & TV, TripAdvisor). Crucially, these natural-language user profiles enable direct user interaction and intervention, allowing users to customize recommendations by correcting misattributed preferences or addressing cold-start settings. We successfully reproduce the core findings of the original study. Additionally, we extend the evaluation by conducting systematic context ablation experiments, multi-seed stability across five distinct random seeds to establish statistical reliability, and a mechanistic interpretability analysis using the nnsight framework to probe internal model representations under counterfactual profile perturbations. Our findings verify the original paper's claim that User Profile Recommendation (UPR) achieves competitive performance under its test-set reranking protocol and makes recommendations more transparent. Perturbing the natural-language profiles does change predictions, but it shifts predicted ratings uniformly across genres with no detectable genre-selective effect, leaving rankings unchanged even under direct activation steering. We trace this back to the rating-regression objective rather than the profile interface, with ranking-objective models clearly exceeding in this task.

</details>


### [296] [The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20050)
*Zhexi Feng,Ruiyi Zhang,Yongbo Yang,Pengtao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出"状态条件下的最小充分证据恢复"任务与SERBench基准，并给出集合构建式的检索方法MSS-Complement，在500个智能体状态上以4-8个证据单元达到73.0%-80.6%的完整证据集恢复率，显著优于重排序基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索按单段落相关性打分，但智能体的"充分性"是集合属性：排序器可能用同一必需事实的多个变体填满预算，导致决策仍缺乏支撑。已有智能体在问题处理中途已读过大量高排名内容，检索应针对其"下一步决策仍缺失的证据"。

Method: 形式化"状态条件下的最小充分证据恢复"任务：给定智能体当前状态，恢复支撑其下一步决策的紧凑证据组合。构建SERBench基准（45个仓库、500个留存状态，记录已见内容，仅当覆盖决策所需全部事实才计分）。提出MSS-Complement，将证据获取视为集合构建而非排序：通过三次语义调用分别提出联合充分集合、搜索缺失部分、返回4-8个完整源码单元（6,144 token内）。

Result: 在标定数据上固定单一配置：5项时完整集合恢复率73.0%、8项时80.6%，对比Qwen3嵌入加重排序的61.4%与72.4%；纯相似度排序对照为66.6%，说明增益来自集合级策略而非算力。在无gold衍生池的冻结仓库源码上领先5.0个百分点。AMA-Bench上答案提示缩小76.2%，准确率高出该基准自有记忆智能体2.08个百分点。从完整集合中移除一个必需组，在两个执行器下分别损失12.3和11.1个百分点的修复定位精度。

Conclusion: 面向智能体的检索更应被建模为"恢复决策所缺证据"，而非"对问题相似度做重排序"；集合级充分性策略是性能提升的关键。

Abstract: A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what a retriever ranks highest. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: a ranker can fill its budget with variants of one required fact and leave the decision unsupported. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination that supplies the support its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen and crediting only sets that cover every fact the current decision was annotated to require. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone reaches 66.6%, placing the gain in the set-level policy, not the computation. From frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool, the lead is 5.0 points. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from an otherwise complete set costs 12.3 and 11.1 points of repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.

</details>


### [297] [Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20131)
*Lijun Liu,Zhengzong Chen,Wenyan Li,Yuanyuan Zhao,Fei Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 MERIT-Rank，通过多视角证据与推理集成来增强基于大语言模型的文本重排序鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的推理式重排序方法大多依赖单一推理轨迹，易受推理错误影响，且难以建模文档相关性背后的多面性信号，导致排序结果不够稳健。

Method: MERIT-Rank 构建了多轨迹推理空间（MTRS），从多个视角评估查询-文档相关性，并引入联合重排序器将多条推理路径整合为统一排序决策；同时提出渐进式排序策略优化（PRPO），通过分阶段优化目标稳定推理轨迹并持续提升排序质量。

Result: 在推理密集型与传统检索基准上，MERIT-Rank 持续优于强竞争基线；其 4B 模型在 BRIGHT 基准上显著超过多数 7B 甚至 32B 重排序器。

Conclusion: 多视角推理轨迹的集成与渐进式策略优化能够有效提升 LLM 重排序的鲁棒性和排序质量，并展现出较强的参数效率优势。

Abstract: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.

</details>


### [298] [FacetCRS: Multi-Faceted Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20175)
*Yongsen Zheng,Ziliang Chen,Jinghui Qin,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出FacetCRS范式，通过多面偏好学习在会话推荐系统中打破过滤气泡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过滤气泡是推荐系统的严重问题，使用户接触的信息范围狭窄。已有研究多关注静态或相对静态的推荐场景，但真实在线推荐中用户与系统的反馈循环会随时间持续加剧过滤气泡。因此需要在会话推荐系统中及时缓解该问题。

Method: 提出FacetCRS（Multi-Facet Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System）。通过自然语言对话中的及时用户-物品交互，将用户偏好自动建模为多面表示，包括实体面、词面、上下文面和评论面，以捕捉多样且动态的用户偏好；构建端到端CRS框架，自适应学习多层级偏好面表示及多种外部知识。

Result: 在两个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在缓解会话推荐系统中的过滤气泡和提升推荐质量方面均达到当前最优性能。

Conclusion: FacetCRS通过多面偏好学习，借助会话式交互有效缓解过滤气泡并提升推荐质量，验证了在动态CRS场景下打破过滤气泡的可行性。

Abstract: The filter bubble is a notorious issue in Recommender Systems (RSs), which describes the phenomenon whereby users are exposed to a limited and narrow range of information or content that reinforces their existing dominant preferences and beliefs. This results in a lack of exposure to diverse and varied content. Many existing works have predominantly examined filter bubbles in static or relatively-static recommendation settings. However, filter bubbles will be continuously intensified over time due to the feedback loop between the user and the system in the real-world online recommendation. To address these issues, we propose a novel paradigm, Multi-Facet Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System (FacetCRS), which aims to burst filter bubbles in the conversational recommender system (CRS) through timely user-item interactions via natural language conversations. By considering diverse user preferences and intentions, FacetCRS automatically model user preference into multi-facets, including entity-, word-, context-, and review-facet, to capture diverse and dynamic user preferences to prick filter bubbles in the CRS. It is an end-to-end CRS framework to adaptively learn representations of various levels of preference facet and diverse types of external knowledge. Extensive experiments on two publicly available benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in mitigating filter bubbles and enhancing recommendation quality in CRS.

</details>


### [299] [Reasoning Quality Matters: Combating Reasoning Collapse in LLM-based Embedding Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20563)
*Zihan Gong,Xiaohan Ye,Jiangchao Yao,Jinsong Lan,Xiaoyong Zhu,Xu Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CoFree两阶段框架，将LLM推理融入查询与文档嵌入优化，缓解"推理崩溃"，在22个数据集上平均提升2.8 nDCG@10。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM嵌入方法要么把嵌入学习视为被动特征提取，要么通过指令跟随利用推理，但面向嵌入目标的专门化会抑制推理生成或产生与检索无关的文本，即"推理崩溃"。需在保留推理质量的同时优化嵌入。

Method: CoFree分两阶段：第一阶段用参考引导的监督微调恢复推理能力并保持基础嵌入模型的表征强度；第二阶段引入嵌入导向奖励与推理导向奖励的双奖励机制，在强化学习中保证面向嵌入目标的细粒度相关性推理，将嵌入学习由静态对齐转为高质量推理引导的检索搜索过程。

Result: 在MTEB与BRIGHT的22个数据集上，CoFree-4B相比Qwen3-Embedding-4B平均绝对提升2.8 nDCG@10；真实检索系统在线实验也有一致增益。

Conclusion: CoFree通过两阶段渐进式融合推理与嵌入优化，有效缓解推理崩溃，兼顾推理质量与检索性能；代码、RTED与模型检查点将公开。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for producing context-rich text embeddings for retrieval. Most existing methods either treat embedding learning as passive feature extraction or exploit LLM reasoning through instruction following for better embedding optimization. However, specialization toward embedding objectives can suppress useful reasoning generation or produce retrieval-irrelevant text. We refer to these two forms of degradation as reasoning collapse. To address this issue, we propose CoFree (Collapse-Free Reasoning Embedding), a two-stage framework that progressively integrates LLM reasoning into query and document embedding optimization while preserving reasoning quality. At the first stage, CoFree applies reference-guided supervised fine-tuning to restore the reasoning ability and retain representational strength of the foundation embedding model. At the second stage, we introduce dual rewards, an embedding-oriented reward and a reasoning-oriented reward, to guarantee fine-grained reasoning of the relevance toward the embedding goal in reinforcement learning. This endpoint-coupled optimization transforms embedding learning from static alignment into a high-quality reasoning-guided search process for retrieval. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CoFree, with CoFree-4B achieving an average absolute improvement of 2.8 nDCG@10 points over Qwen3-Embedding-4B across 22 datasets from MTEB and BRIGHT. Online experiments in a real-world retrieval system further show consistent gains. Code, RTED, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

### [300] [A Cross-Lingual Acoustic Disease-Alignment Framework for Respiratory Health Assessment from Spontaneous Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19398)
*Roksana Khanom,Raghib Asfak Tasnim,Bodrun Nahar Bithi,Shafia Shirin Supty,Saiful Islam Raju,Ashok Agrawala,Nirupam Roy*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出CL-DAF跨语言疾病对齐框架，通过272维声学表示与语言不变性评分筛选出26个疾病对齐特征，将英孟双向跨语言COPD识别AUC从0.49提升至0.825/0.722。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自发语音是评估呼吸健康可扩展、非侵入的信号，但疾病相关声学变化与语言特异的语音变异相混淆，导致可解释且跨语言泛化的模型难以构建。

Method: 使用201名英语与75名新采集孟加拉语说话者（COPD与对照），构建统一的272维声学表示；用带符号秩双列效应量与Language Invariance Score量化疾病对齐程度；CL-DAF据此筛选跨语言疾病效应方向一致的声学特征。

Result: 孟加拉语自发语音可区分COPD与对照（AUC 0.85）；但133个特征疾病方向跨语言反转，全表示跨语言迁移差（孟→英AUC 0.49）；CL-DAF隔离出26个疾病对齐特征后，英→孟与孟→英AUC分别达0.825与0.722。

Conclusion: 跨语言疾病对齐特征可有效缓解语言依赖变异带来的干扰，为强调病理而非语言差异的多语言临床语音模型奠定基础。

Abstract: Spontaneous speech offers a scalable, noninvasive signal for respiratory health assessment, yet interpretable models that generalize across languages remain challenging because disease-related acoustic changes are confounded by language-specific phonetic variation. We present CL-DAF, a Cross-Lingual Disease-Alignment Framework that identifies acoustic dimensions whose disease effects remain consistent across languages. Using 201 English and 75 newly collected Bangla speakers, we construct a common 272-dimensional acoustic representation and quantify disease alignment using signed rank-biserial effects and the Language Invariance Score. We first show that spontaneous Bangla speech separates COPD from controls (AUC 0.85); however, 133 features reverse their disease direction across languages and the full representation transfers poorly (AUC 0.49 from Bangla to English). CL-DAF isolates 26 disease-aligned features that raise AUCs to 0.825 and 0.722 from English to Bangla and Bangla to English, respectively. These findings provide a foundation for multilingual clinical speech models emphasizing pathology over language-dependent variation.

</details>


### [301] [A State-Space Model of Figured-Bass Realization: Local Constraints, Coupled Voices, and Polynomial-Time Solvability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19397)
*Evan Unit Lim*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文对考试风格的四声部数字低音实现问题给出显式数学模型，将音高拼写、音域、和弦归属、重复、省略、间距、交叉、重叠、旋律进行、连续完全音程及解决要求等表示为谓词，区分硬约束与可选偏好代价。以有序声部状态为结点、合法进行为分层图路径，证明在固定声部数、有限音域与固定局部规则下，可行性与最小代价实现均属多项式时间问题；固定音域与音高字母表时，图操作数与事件数线性相关。二、四、八拍实例演示了合法性、优化及贪心选择的失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字低音实现涉及每一音响内部与相邻音响之间的多重选择约束，既有硬性规则也有可权衡的偏好。作者希望把这一实践性任务形式化为可计算问题，明确哪些条件是不可违反的硬约束、哪些是可加权的偏好代价，从而为可行性判定与最小代价求解提供严格基础。

Method: 将音高拼写、音域、和弦成员、重复、省略、间距、交叉、重叠、旋律运动、连续完全音程以及部分解决要求表示为谓词；把硬约束与可选偏好代价分离。用四个带标签音符构成一个有序声部状态，并以四边形顶点作可视化表示。合法进行构成分层图中的路径，进而分析其计算复杂性，并用二、四、八拍实例进行说明。

Result: 证明在声部数固定、音符域明确有限且局部规则固定的条件下，可行性与最小代价实现都是多项式时间可解问题。对于固定音域、固定音高字母表和相邻事件规则，图操作数量与事件数量呈线性关系。实例展示了合法性、优化过程，以及贪心选择可能失败的情形。

Conclusion: 该结论仅针对所陈述的形式模型，并不主张所有音乐判断都能被局部谓词完全刻画。模型的价值在于把数字低音实现中的硬约束与偏好代价清晰分离，并给出可计算、可分析的图路径表述及其复杂度界限。

Abstract: Figured-bass realization can be described as a sequence of choices constrained both within each sonority and between successive sonorities. This paper gives an explicit mathematical model of a restricted, examination-style four-part realization problem. Pitch spelling, range, chord membership, doubling, omission, spacing, crossing, overlap, melodic motion, consecutive perfect intervals, and selected resolution requirements are expressed as predicates. We distinguish hard constraints from optional preference costs. Four labeled notes are represented visually as the vertices of a quadrilateral and computationally as one ordered voicing state. Legal progressions become paths through a layered graph. We prove that feasibility and minimum-cost realization are polynomial-time problems for a fixed number of voices with explicit finite note domains and fixed local rules. For fixed ranges, a fixed note alphabet, and adjacent-event rules, the number of graph operations is linear in the number of events. Worked two-, four-, and eight-beat examples illustrate legality, optimization, and the failure of a greedy choice. The result concerns the stated formal model; it is not a claim that every musical judgment is captured by local predicates.

</details>


### [302] [CoRELoop: Parameter-Efficient Controlled Recurrent Refinement for Audio Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19818)
*Kunyu Feng,Yuxiang Wang,Li Wang,Wan Lin,Zhizheng Wu*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出 CoReLoop，在冻结的 SSL 音频深伪检测器上通过轻量循环精炼模块与低秩适配器实现迭代精炼，提升跨域泛化，24 层模型两遍 EER 由 4.85% 降至 3.74%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频深伪检测器对未见攻击泛化困难，而收集覆盖所有潜在攻击的训练数据不现实；因此希望在已训练好的 SSL 检测器上实现循环精炼，且不增加数据、不改变原有参数。但直接复用编码器输出作为输入会导致检测性能下降。

Method: CoReLoop 使循环复用变得有效：将循环输入适配到冻结编码器、控制状态更新，并将精炼输出与冻结分类器对齐。仅训练轻量精炼模块和循环专属低秩适配器（在原数据上），在保留检测器原有首遍预测的前提下实现额外精炼；并引入可选的 halting head 为每条语音选择精炼深度。

Result: 在 14 个跨域测试集上，24 层模型两遍将 pooled EER 从 4.85% 降至 3.74%，可训练参数约 10M（总 598M）。可选 halting head 平均 1.18 遍即可达 3.73% pooled EER。

Conclusion: 通过冻结主干、仅训练轻量循环精炼与低秩适配器，可在不改变原检测器首遍预测的情况下有效利用循环精炼提升跨域泛化；配合选择性 halting 机制，能以极小的额外计算代价取得与固定多遍相当甚至更优的性能。

Abstract: Generalizing to unseen attacks remains challenging for audio deepfake detectors, and collecting training data covering all potential attacks is impractical. We explore recurrent refinement in an already-trained SSL-based detector without additional data or changes to its original parameters. However, directly recycling encoder outputs as inputs degrades detection in our diagnostic. We propose CoReLoop, which makes this reuse effective by adapting recurrent inputs to the frozen encoder, controlling state updates, and aligning refined outputs with the frozen classifier. By training only lightweight refinement modules and loop-specific low-rank adapters on the original data, CoReLoop enables additional refinement while preserving the detector's original first-pass prediction. On 14 cross-domain test sets, the 24-layer model reduces pooled equal error rate (EER) from 4.85% to 3.74% with two passes, with approximately 10M trainable parameters out of 598M. To selectively apply this refinement, an optional halting head chooses the depth for each utterance, achieving 3.73% pooled EER with an average of 1.18 passes.

</details>


### [303] [Robust Workflow Generation via Adversarial Learning for Audio Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20063)
*Xiang Li,Pin-Yu Chen,Wenqi Wei*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出ROGUE框架，通过双智能体对抗学习动态编排多种检测工具，构建鲁棒的音频深伪检测工作流，在真实扰动下显著提升鲁棒性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音合成与语音转换技术快速发展使音频深伪愈发逼真，带来严重安全风险。现有检测方法在受控条件下表现良好，但在真实世界的扰动与损坏下泛化能力差，难以满足实际部署需求。

Method: ROGUE将工作流生成建模为序列决策问题，引入双智能体范式：扰动智能体生成音频扰动，策略智能体学习在扰动条件下选择并执行检测工具；通过对抗学习实现扰动感知的工具选择、自适应执行策略以及对分布偏移的鲁棒性。

Result: 在多数据集与多种真实损坏条件下的大量实验表明，ROGUE在鲁棒性和泛化性上均持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明，对抗优化的工流生成对构建真实部署场景下可靠的音频深伪检测系统是有效的。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of speech synthesis and voice conversion technologies has made audio deepfakes increasingly realistic, posing serious security risks in practical applications. While existing detection methods achieve strong performance under controlled conditions, they often fail to generalize under real-world perturbations and corruptions. In this paper, we propose ROGUE, a framework that dynamically constructs robust detection workflows by orchestrating multiple detection tools. ROGUE formulates workflow generation as a sequential decision-making problem and introduces a dual-agent paradigm, where a perturbation agent generates audio perturbations and a policy agent learns to select and execute detection tools under perturbed conditions. Through adversarial learning, ROGUE enables perturbation-aware tool selection, adaptive execution strategies, and improved robustness to distribution shifts. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and real-world corruptions demonstrate that ROGUE consistently outperforms strong baselines in both robustness and generalization. Our results highlight the effectiveness of adversarially optimized workflow generation for building reliable audio deepfake detection systems in real-world deployment settings.

</details>


### [304] [CircleMatch: Prototype Matching with Circular Temporal Statistics for Tiny Keyword Spotting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20070)
*Jiajun Sun,Zhe Gao*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出CircleMatch匹配框架，以极低参数量（约1k–7k）实现关键词识别，在多数据集上取得有竞争力准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音设备需在严格参数预算下实现高关键词识别准确率，且需适配不同词表规模，这一挑战尚未很好解决。

Method: 编码器分别压缩频带并融合为帧特征，再与学习的类别原型匹配生成时间响应曲线；采用无参数圆形聚合，将时间编码为角度，汇总响应分布与相对时序进行分类。开发了Circle-D4/D8/D16/D32四个微型变体。

Result: 在12类设置下参数量约1k至7k；在Speech Commands v1/v2及Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus英语、西班牙语Micro子集上多随机种子实验，以微型模型取得有竞争力准确率。定性分析表明原型响应具有近似平移等变性并能适应时间压缩。

Conclusion: CircleMatch以极少参数实现有竞争力的KWS性能，原型匹配与圆形聚合设计有效，代码与权重已开源。

Abstract: Keyword spotting (KWS), the task of identifying predefined words in speech, is a core capability of voice-enabled devices. Achieving high KWS accuracy under tight parameter budgets across different vocabulary sizes remains challenging. We present CircleMatch, a matching framework enabling KWS with very few parameters. Its encoder independently compresses frequency bands and fuses them into frame features. These features are then matched against learned class-specific prototypes to produce temporal response curves. Parameter-free circular aggregation encodes time as angles and summarizes response distributions and relative timing for classification. We develop four tiny variants, Circle-D4, Circle-D8, Circle-D16, and Circle-D32, ranging from approximately 1k to 7k parameters in the 12-class setting. Experiments with multiple random seeds on Speech Commands v1/v2 and the English and Spanish Micro subsets of the Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus demonstrate competitive accuracy with tiny models. Our qualitative analysis further suggests approximate shift equivariance of prototype responses and adaptation to temporal compression. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/ora942878/CircleMatch.

</details>


### [305] [Multi-Dimensional Prosody Judgment For Live Streaming Speech Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20124)
*Zifan Guan,Longyu Lu,Junan Zhang,Zhizheng Wu,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出低成本成对评测器LPJ（从Gemini蒸馏至Qwen3-Omni），识别多维评测中的"判定耦合"问题，并进一步提出D-LPJ通过去除总体判定、掩码不确定维度及span-local GRPO解耦各维度评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直播流式TTS评测需细粒度、高表现力的韵律评价（情感、语调、能量），传统MOS预测器无法捕捉；而Gemini等专有LLM评测成本过高，难以支撑大规模推理与强化学习反馈。

Method: 1) Live-ProsodyJudge (LPJ)：从Gemini蒸馏至Qwen3-Omni的性价比成对评测器；2) 诊断标准多维评测中的"verdict coupling"缺陷（评测器将各维度分与总体偏好对齐，导致多维评分退化为单一偏好位）；3) Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge (D-LPJ)：移除总体判定目标防止盲从、在SFT中对不确定的成对维度进行掩码、提出span-local GRPO将归一化优势严格应用于对应理由片段。

Result: 在精选人工标注测试集上，10样本平衡顺序的LPJ点准确率高于单次Gemini调用；D-LPJ成功产出独立解耦的维度判定；在Best-of-8 TTS候选选择锦标赛中，LPJ所选语句在高置信案例中有85.29%落入人类前三。

Conclusion: LPJ以低成本达到并超越专有LLM的评测精度，D-LPJ有效解决维度耦合问题，整体方案可用于细粒度TTS偏好优化。

Abstract: Evaluating live streaming speech synthesis (TTS) requires assessing fine-grained, highly expressive prosody such as emotion, intonation, and energy which traditional MOS predictors fail to capture. While proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) like Gemini can evaluate these aspects, they are too costly for massive inference and reinforcement learning feedback. To address this, we first introduce Live-ProsodyJudge (LPJ), a cost-effective pairwise evaluator distilled from Gemini into Qwen3-Omni. However, we identify a critical flaw in standard multi-dimensional evaluation: verdict coupling. The judge tends to lazily align all individual dimension scores with its overall preference, collapsing a rich multi-dimensional rubric into a single preference bit. To resolve this, we further propose Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge (D-LPJ). D-LPJ eliminates the overall verdict target to prevent blind following, masks uncertain pair-dimensions during Supervised Fine-Tuning(SFT), and introduces a novel span-local GRPO strategy that applies normalized advantages strictly to their corresponding rationale spans. Evaluated on highly curated human-annotated test sets, 10 sample balanced-order LPJ achieves higher point accuracy than a single Gemini call, while D-LPJ successfully produces independent,decoupled dimension judgments. Furthermore, in a Best-of-8 TTS candidate selection tournament, the LPJ-selected utterance falls within the human top-3 in 85.29% of high-confidence cases, demonstrating its efficacy for fine-grained TTS preference optimization.

</details>


### [306] [Music Hallucination in Audio-Language Models: A Hierarchical Formulation and Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20195)
*Yu Liu,Jiahui Liu,Zhilin Liu,Cong Cao,Fangfang Yuan,Yuling Yang,Pin Xu,Yanbing Liu*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文首次针对音频-语言模型的音乐幻觉开展分层、多范式实证研究，提出五层感知接地失败框架与 MuseDiag 诊断框架，评测九个模型并给出两种免训练缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频-语言模型越来越多地生成自信但与输入音频不符的音乐描述（幻觉），而现有研究缺乏针对音乐领域、分层、多范式的系统性诊断与评测手段。

Method: 将音乐幻觉形式化为跨五层（声音事件、时间属性、音调属性、风格、情感）的层级化感知接地失败；提出基于矛盾验证的多范式诊断框架 MuseDiag；评测四个开源与五个闭源共九个模型；提出两种免训练缓解方法——音乐音频依赖感知解码（ADD-M）与分类引导感知锚定（TPA）。

Result: （1）人声误感知为九个模型共有弱点，音调感知是架构差异化的主要维度，Audio-Flamingo-3 稳定领先，其下模型排序显著变化并揭示范式特异的脆弱性特征；（2）肯定偏见、生成模式效应与层特异性感知局限均与观察模式经验相关，但仅为多分析汇聚证据而非严格因果归因；（3）ADD-M 与 TPA 在探测任务中可降低幻觉，但增益随模型而异且常无法迁移至自由生成。

Conclusion: 音乐幻觉缓解必须在多种范式下评估，因为探测任务上的改进未必能推广到自由形式生成，单一范式的缓解评价不足以保证效果。

Abstract: Audio-language models increasingly generate confident music descriptions that are unsupported by the input audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first music-specific, layer-wise, multi-paradigm empirical study of hallucination in audio-language models and formulate it as a hierarchical perceptual grounding failure across five layers: sound events, temporal properties, tonal attributes, style, and emotion. We introduce MuseDiag, a multi-paradigm diagnostic framework with contradiction-based verification, and evaluate nine models (four open-source and five closed-source). We find that (1) vocal misperception is a universal weakness across all nine models, tonal perception is a major axis of architectural differentiation, and Audio-Flamingo-3 remains the stable leader while substantial reordering below it reveals paradigm-specific vulnerability profiles; (2) affirmative bias, generation-mode effects, and layer-specific perceptual limitations are each empirically associated with the observed patterns, with convergent evidence from multiple analyses rather than strict causal attribution; and (3) our two training-free mitigation methods, Audio-Dependency-Aware Decoding for Music (ADD-M) and Taxonomy-Guided Perceptual Anchoring (TPA), can reduce hallucination in probing, but their gains vary by model and often do not carry over to free-form generation, showing that music hallucination mitigation must be evaluated across paradigms.

</details>

### [307] [From Models to Systems: A Comprehensive Survey of Efficient Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19445)
*Pan Wang,Siwei Song,Hui Ji,Siqi Cao,Heng Yu,Zhijian Liu,Huanrui Yang,Yingyan Celine Lin,Beidi Chen,Mohit Bansal,Xiaoming Liu,Pengfei Zhou,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Tianlong Chen,Jingtong Hu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理高效多模态学习（EML），提出首个"模型-算法-系统"三级层次分类法，综合逾300项工作，揭示跨层协同设计与"效率-效用-隐私"权衡，并以MLLM为例给出全栈资源编排的演进脉络与领域优化蓝图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型快速扩张带来计算、内存与部署瓶颈，推动EML成为前沿方向；但现有研究对"效率体现在何处、如何实现、在哪一层实现"缺乏连贯统一的认识，知识呈碎片化。因此需要一个结构化、贯通学习栈的整合框架。

Method: 综述方法：构建首个结构化、从模型到系统的分类法，将300余篇代表性工作归纳为模型、算法、系统三个层级，分别对应架构精简、执行优化与硬件感知编排；并提出跨层纵向协同的方法论综合，剖析协同设计如何支撑"效率-效用-隐私"三元权衡，再以多模态大语言模型（MLLM）开展整合式案例研究。

Result: 给出三层级分类体系与跨层协同的方法论综合；通过MLLM案例刻画领域从早期结构调优到现代全栈资源编排的演进轨迹；提供面向多领域的整体讨论与应用特定优化蓝图，并提出向"自调节智能"的范式转变——效率成为模型基本设计内在涌现的属性而非事后约束。

Conclusion: 该综述为多模态系统建立了结构化框架，指向高性能、强泛化且原生高效、可普适部署的目标；同时列出开放挑战与未来方向，并维护持续更新的公开资源库。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of multimodal models has surfaced formidable bottlenecks in computation, memory, and deployment, catalyzing the rise of Efficient Multimodal Learning (EML) as a pivotal research frontier. Despite intensive progress, a cohesive understanding of what, how, and where efficiency is manifested across the learning stack remains fragmented. This survey systematizes the EML landscape by introducing the first structured, model-to-system taxonomy. We distill insights from over 300 seminal works into three hierarchical levels--model, algorithm, and system--addressing architectural parsimony, execution refinement, and hardware-aware orchestration, respectively. Moving beyond a purely categorical review, we offer a methodological synthesis of the vertical synergies between these layers, elucidating how cross-layer co-design contributes to the fundamental "Efficiency-Utility-Privacy" trade-off. Through an integrative case study of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we trace the field's evolutionary trajectory from initial structural adjustments to modern full-stack resource orchestration. Furthermore, we provide a holistic discussion and application-specific optimization blueprints for diverse domains and posit a paradigm shift toward self-regulating intelligence, where efficiency is an intrinsic, emergent property of the model's fundamental design rather than a post-hoc constraint. Finally, we present open challenges and future directions that will define the trajectory of EML research. This survey establishes a structured framework for multimodal systems that are not only high-performing and generalizable but natively efficient and ready for ubiquitous deployment. A continuously updated version is available at https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey.

</details>


### [308] [Trigger Timing, Deadline Readiness, and Event-Aligned Accounting for Dynamic Ad Insertion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19899)
*Prashant Chaudhary,Kapil Khandelwal*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文通过"观测事件账本、候选无关参考截止期、pod级贡献核算"三件工具，将动态广告插入中易被混淆的触发、触达、就绪、播放、计费与测量事件分离，并用离线合成实验（45,000条共享脚本、9+9条件）检验定义对结论的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态广告插入的性能比较常把触发、触达、就绪、播放、计费与测量混为一谈，即使算术上正确，也可能因事件定义混淆而产生误导性结论。作者希望明确这些事件的定义与边界，识别哪些捷径近似会改变结论、哪些不会。

Method: 提出三类方法：(1) 观测事件账本，记录各事件的真实发生；(2) 候选无关的参考截止期（在候选分配前固定），检验截止期处是否存在可接受的转移状态，而非仅看准备是否更早完成；(3) pod级贡献核算。同时给出受限单调播放表示，刻画何时媒体位置摘要足够，并用反例说明更广路径类下其失效。开展离线合成研究：9个短生命周期条件（对就绪比较有信息量）+9个长生命周期条件（解析对照），45,000条共享脚本，两种触发策略共享播放路径、时延抽样与假设价值/成本系数。

Result: 在非单调混合下，播放头摘要对触达事件存在显著误分类；但在该网格中两种捷径均未逆转贡献对比，因共享设计下部分误差相互抵消。将"截止期处有效性"替换为"截止期前完成"，在9个信息性条件中的3个（均位于三种时延设置之一）逆转了比较结论。按实际观众到达而非参考截止期评估就绪，会改变暂停路径的就绪判定，但不改变贡献符号。保守界在记录缺失时保留不确定性；工件包含代码、随机种子、事件历史与检验流程。

Conclusion: 上述结果是事件定义作用于既有误分类机制的必然后果。证据为合成数据，未使用商业遥测，也不对服务器端插入与服务器引导插入进行排名。研究强调：比较动态广告插入时必须先厘清事件定义，否则算术正确的核算仍可能得出被定义驱动的、方向性错误的结论。

Abstract: Dynamic ad insertion comparisons can conflate trigger, reach, readiness, playback, billability and measurement even when the accounting is arithmetically correct. We separate these events with an observed-event ledger, a candidate-invariant reference deadline and pod-level contribution accounting. The deadline rule is fixed before candidate assignment and tests whether an admissible transition state remains valid, not whether preparation merely finished earlier. A restricted monotone-playback representation states when media-position summaries suffice; a counterexample shows why they fail over a wider path class. An offline synthetic study exercises the definitions over nine short-lifetime conditions informative for the readiness comparison and nine long-lifetime conditions serving as analytic controls. Across 45,000 shared scripts, two trigger policies share imposed playback paths, latency draws and hypothetical value and cost coefficients. Playhead summaries substantially misclassify reach events in the nonmonotone mixtures, yet neither shortcut reverses the contribution contrast in this grid, because some errors cancel under the shared design. Replacing validity at the deadline with completion by the deadline reverses the comparison in three of the nine informative conditions, all at one of the three latency settings. Scoring readiness at actual viewer arrival rather than at the reference deadline shifts pause-path readiness but changes no contribution sign. These outcomes are consequences of the event definitions applied to established misclassification mechanisms. Conservative bounds retain uncertainty when records are missing, and the artifact records code, seeds, event histories and checking procedures. The evidence is synthetic, uses no commercial telemetry, and ranks neither server-side nor server-guided insertion.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [309] [Federated Soft Clustering via Generalized Total Variation Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19202)
*Shamsiiat Abdurakhmanova,Alexander Jung*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦软聚类：各设备持有私有数据并拟合个性化高斯混合模型，通过广义全变差最小化（GTVMin）用图正则项耦合局部最大似然问题，比较三种模型差异度量，并给出一致同步投影梯度优化与MMD情形的收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中对每个设备进行个性化建模（如GMM软聚类）时，需要在各节点独立拟合与模型间一致性之间取得平衡。图正则化框架GTVMin可实现这种折中，但正则项中"差异度量"的选取是关键设计决策，直接影响是否需要组件匹配、优化难度与对数据异构性的鲁棒性，因此有必要系统比较不同度量方案。

Method: 将每个设备的个性化GMM拟合表述为局部最大似然问题，并用惩罚相连节点模型差异的图正则项（GTVMin）进行耦合。比较三种差异度量：(1) 模型参数间的平方欧氏距离（需组件匹配）；(2) 蒙特卡洛近似的KL散度（直接比较分布，无需匹配）；(3) 闭式最大均值差异（MMD，同样无需匹配）。三种GTVMin实例均采用同步投影梯度更新求解，并针对光滑的MMD实例给出收敛到稳定点的理论保证。

Result: 给出了三种GTVMin实例的求解方案：均由同步投影梯度更新优化，其中MMD实例因目标光滑可获得收敛至稳定点的保证；并对三种度量刻画了计算开销，评估了它们对数据异构性的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 差异度量的选择在联邦个性化GMM聚类中至关重要：参数级欧氏距离需要组件匹配，而基于分布的KL（蒙特卡洛近似）与MMD可直接比较分布、免去匹配步骤，其中MMD具有闭式表达与收敛保证。不同度量在计算成本与异构数据鲁棒性上各有取舍。

Abstract: We study federated soft clustering over federated learning (FL) networks of devices that each hold a private local dataset and fit a personalized Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Generalized total variation minimization (GTVMin) couples the local maximum likelihood problems through a graph regularizer that penalizes a discrepancy between the models of connected nodes. The choice of discrepancy measure is a key design decision: we compare a squared Euclidean distance between model parameters, which requires component matching, with two measures that compare the local model distributions directly and hence need no matching: a Monte-Carlo approximated Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and a closed-form maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). All three resulting GTVMin instances are optimized by synchronous projected gradient updates; for the smooth MMD instance we provide a convergence guarantee to stationary points. We characterize their computational cost and evaluate their robustness to data heterogeneity.

</details>


### [310] [Learning Submanifolds for Subsequent Inference on Random Dot Product Graphs, Part 1: Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19357)
*Michael W. Trosset,Carey E. Priebe*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对随机点积图（RDPG）的受限推断框架，其潜在位置位于未知低维支撑流形上。作者设计了半监督决策规则，利用辅助数据通过Isomap学习流形，并证明了随辅助样本量增加，其风险收敛到oracle规则的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机点积图的潜在位置通常被假定位于低维欧氏空间，但实际中真实支撑结构（支撑流形）是未知的。如何在受限推断（restricted inference）下有效利用这一未知低维几何结构进行一般决策问题，是一个待解决的问题；同时希望借助辅助数据来学习该流形以改进决策。

Method: 提出半监督决策规则：使用Isomap流形学习过程，从观测图中构造潜在位置的低维欧氏表示；在该空间中，用一个等距不变函数（isometrically invariant function）将点配置映射到动作（决策）。理论分析随辅助样本量增大时规则的行为。

Result: 证明了随着辅助样本量增加，半监督规则的风险收敛到oracle规则的风险；该oracle规则依赖于能够从支撑流形中提取的最大量的低维欧氏结构。

Conclusion: 该框架为在未知低维支撑流形上的RDPG受限推断提供了一致的半监督决策方法，其性能在辅助数据充足时渐近达到oracle水平。示例、应用与仿真研究留待后续文章（sequel）。

Abstract: We propose a framework for restricted inference on random dot product graphs whose latent positions lie on an unknown low-dimensional support manifold. For general decision problems, we propose semisupervised decision rules that use auxiliary data to learn the support manifold. Specifically, our rules use the Isomap manifold learning procedure to construct a low-dimensional Euclidean representation of the observed graph, in which space an isometrically invariant function maps configurations of points to actions. We study the behavior of the proposed rules as the quantity of auxiliary data sampled from the unknown support manifold increases. We show that, as the auxiliary sample size increases, the risk of the semisupervised rule converges to the risk of an oracle rule that relies on the maximal amount of low-dimensional Euclidean structure that can be extracted from the support manifold. Examples, applications, and simulation studies are deferred to a sequel.

</details>


### [311] [Null importance: Disentangling relevance for interpretable machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19511)
*Garvesh Raskutti,Kris Sankaran,Jiaxin Ye*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文以“零重要性”（null importance）为核心，建立可解释机器学习中特征重要性的统一统计框架，区分边际/条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性与因果效应等不同相关性概念，刻画其等价条件与分歧反例，并连接科学问题、数据/模型假设与方法家族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "重要性"一词在可解释机器学习中包含若干本质不同的相关性概念，现有研究常将它们混用，导致在算法公平性与基因组扰动建模等场景中产生误导性结论。作者希望澄清"特征何时无关"这一问题依赖于具体指定的相关性定义，从而避免用错重要性概念推断科学结论。

Method: 提出基于零重要性的统一视角：以总体层面刻画特征在给定相关性概念下何时无关。系统考察来自边际与条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性及因果效应的标准零重要性概念；给出使不同零概念重合的充分条件，并构造条件失效时概念分歧的反例；进一步刻画不同方法家族所针对的零目标，以及其零重要性统计量何时能识别这些目标。通过涵盖特征依赖、冗余、非线性、隐藏特征等的模拟，以及图像与多组学数据的案例研究进行验证。

Result: 理论上建立了不同零重要性概念之间的等价充分条件与分歧反例，并明确了各方法家族的零目标和零重要性统计量的识别条件；模拟实验在特征依赖、冗余、非线性、隐藏特征等常见现象下为理论区分提供经验证据；图像与多组学案例研究展示了这些区分在实际应用中的后果，例如算法公平性中常见公平性准则对应不同的零重要性概念，基因组扰动建模中不同相关性概念导致对模型所学内容的不同结论。

Conclusion: 该框架为关联科学问题、数据生成假设与算法提供了共同的统计语言，澄清了特征重要性分析所能支持的结论及其边界，有助于研究者根据具体科学问题选择恰当的相关性概念与重要性评估方法。

Abstract: Feature importance is central to interpretable machine learning, but the term "importance" encompasses several fundamentally different notions of relevance. We develop a unified perspective based on null importance: a population-level characterization of when a feature is irrelevant under a specified notion of relevance. We consider standard notions of null importance arising from marginal and conditional statistical relevance, predictive risk, functional invariance, and causal effects, and show how these notions answer different scientific questions. We illustrate the framework in two applications in which the distinction is particularly consequential: algorithmic fairness, where common fairness criteria correspond to different notions of null importance, and genomic perturbation modeling, where different notions of relevance lead to different conclusions about what a prediction model has learned. The framework connects three aspects of feature analysis: the scientific question defining relevance, the data and model assumptions that shape how different null notions relate, and the methods used to assess importance. We establish sufficient conditions under which null notions coincide and give counterexamples showing how they diverge when those conditions fail. We then characterize which nulls different method families target and when their zero-importance statistics identify those targets. Finally, simulations spanning feature dependence, redundancy, nonlinearity, hidden features and other standard phenomena, along with case studies on image and multiomics data, provide empirical evidence for these theoretical distinctions and their practical consequences. Taken together, these results provide a common statistical language for relating scientific questions, data-generating assumptions, and algorithms, and clarify the conclusions that feature-importance analyses can support.

</details>


### [312] [Next-token functional estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19529)
*Milind Nakul,Vidya Muthukumar,Ashwin Pananjady*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出leave-a-window-out估计方法，用于估计时间依赖序列中与下一token相关的泛函，证明其在平稳β-混合过程下达到参数收敛速率，并给出极小极大下界与仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 估计下一token泛函（如新颖性概率、最小距离尾概率、分类器测试误差）时，经典leave-one-out方法在时间依赖下不一致，需要适用于序列依赖数据的估计方法。

Method: 提出leave-a-window-out估计器：在每个索引后删除长度为τ的窗口再构造经验测度，τ=1时退化为leave-one-out。在平稳β-混合且容许Marton耦合的过程假设下分析误差。

Result: 证明该估计器误差在平稳β-混合并容许Marton耦合过程下以参数速率衰减，覆盖多种泛函；针对混合马尔可夫链上的surprise probability给出尖锐的极小极大下界；在马尔可夫链、移动平均和自回归过程仿真中，该方法在许多leave-one-out和add-constant基线失效场景下成功。

Conclusion: leave-a-window-out为时间依赖序列中的下一token泛函估计提供了具有理论保证且实验有效的方案，克服了leave-one-out在依赖数据下的不一致性。

Abstract: Suppose we observe the first $n$ points of a sequence of random variables having length $n+1$, and wish to estimate a functional of the unobserved final point and the empirical measure of the $n$ observed training points. Such next-token functionals include the probability that the next token is novel (also known as the surprise probability), the tail probability of the minimum distance between the next token and training points, and the test error of a classifier trained on the observed points.
