*Zewen Yang,Xiaobing Dai,Zhenxiao Yin,Hang Zhao,Zhijun Li,C. C. Chan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对分布式传感网络中部分状态观测下的状态估计与部分未知动力学联合估计问题，提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，结合在线分布式高斯过程回归，并给出数据采集策略与误差上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式传感网络中，系统状态与部分未知动力学需要联合估计，但实际场景往往只能获得部分状态观测，且高斯过程模型本身存在缺陷，导致估计困难。

Method: 提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，融合在线分布式高斯过程（GP）回归；引入新的数据采集策略，并给出确保数据获取可行的理论条件；利用GP的确定性误差界推导状态估计与模型估计的误差上界。

Result: 在测量不完整和GP模型欠缺的情况下仍能实现准确估计；理论分析给出了联合误差上界；仿真实验表明该方法优于现有基于分布式GP的方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为分布式传感网络中的联合状态与动力学估计提供了有效方案，并通过理论保证与仿真验证了其优越性。

Abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of jointly estimating the system states and partially unknown dynamics within distributed sensor-equipped networks, particularly in scenarios where only partial state observations are available. To address this issue, we propose an observer-based dynamic cooperative learning framework incorporating online distributed Gaussian Process (GP) regression, which enables accurate estimation despite incomplete in measurements and deficient GP models. In addition, a novel data collection strategy is introduced, with theoretical conditions ensuring feasible data acquisition. Moreover, we also derive an error upper bound encompassing state estimation and model estimation, leveraging the deterministic error bounds of GPs. Empirical simulations demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to existing distributed GP-based methods.

</details>


### [419] [Multi-center Medical Data Mining with FL-Net - A One-stop Shop for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20650)
*Simon Süwer,Julian Klemm,Elisa Acitelli,Mathieu Almeida,Lucia Altucci,Zsolt Bagyura,Michelangela Barbieri,Zsolt-Zoltán Bedő,Rosaria Benedetti,Béla Bihari,Csongor Csalóka,Lucia Dicunta,Stanislav Ehrlich,Bjoern M. Eskofier,Sándor-József Fejér,Georg Fröwis,Walter Hötzendorfer,Alexandra Kautzky-Willer,Jens Johann Georg Lohmann,Marianna Maranghi,Lorenzo Marconi,Rudolf Mayer,Wouter Leonard Megchelenbrink,Monika Moga,Adham Mottalib,Sanjeev Mehta,Madeleine Müller,Thomas Nyström,Balázs-Attila Orbán,Paul O'Toole,Giuseppe Paolisso,Paolo Parini,Matteo Pedrelli,Enrico Petrillo,Philipp Poindl,Niklas Probul,Anastasia Pustozerova,Tanja Šarčević,Lukas Weilguny,Jan Baumbach,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有联邦学习研究多为仿真、且缺乏满足临床研究需求的框架，提出FL-Net以满足全部五项需求，并进行了端到端验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可支持不共享患者级数据的协作训练，但多数研究仍停留在仿真阶段，缺乏系统化的需求分析与真正的临床研究框架支撑。

Method: 从文献中提炼五项需求，对14个FL框架进行分析；提出FL-Net框架，集成模块化数据协调、数据发现、披露控制、安全版本化的FL-Net-Tools及容器化联邦工作流执行。

Result: 无一现有框架完全满足五项需求；FL-Net通过数据协调、跨研究患者发现（MIMIC与US-130）、可复现且可审计的联邦工作流（最多50个并发客户端）完成端到端评估。

Conclusion: FL-Net在dAIbetes与Microb-AI-ome欧盟项目中开发，将覆盖9国10家医院逾80万患者，为可互操作、可复现且隐私保护的多中心临床研究提供实用基础。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative training without sharing patient-level data, but most studies remain simulations. Based on five requirements derived from the literature, we analyzed 14 FL frameworks and found that none fully satisfied these requirements. We present FL-Net, a novel federated clinical research framework to fulfill all requirements. It integrates modular data harmonization, data discovery, disclosure control, securely built versioned FL-Net-Tools and containerized federated workflow execution into a persistent network. It enables the re-use of harmonized data and workflows across studies. FL-Net's end-to-end capabilities were evaluated through harmonization, cross-study patient discovery across MIMIC and US-130, and reproducible, audited federated workflows with up to 50 concurrent clients. FL-Net is being developed within the dAIbetes and Microb-AI-ome EU projects and will cover over 800,000 patients across 10 hospitals in 9 countries covering longitudinal and single point in time data, FL-Net provides a practical foundation for interoperable, reproducible, and privacy-preserving multicenter clinical research.

</details>


### [420] [RISC-V and machine learning: a survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20677)
*Shriman Keshri,Apparna Singh,Chinmaya Kumar Palo,Shreya Adya,Subhankar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述RISC-V指令集架构在机器学习中的应用现状，涵盖商用与学术实现、软件框架及真实部署，提出统一分类法并指出标准化、验证复杂度与生态碎片化等挑战，最后给出四个未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源处理器架构与机器学习的交汇催生了对可定制、高效、易获取硬件的需求，因此需要系统性梳理RISC-V在机器学习领域的现有能力、瓶颈与演进趋势。

Method: 采用文献综述方法，基于近期研究对RISC-V机器学习生态进行评估，范围包括指令集扩展、核心实现、编译器优化与部署策略，并进行性能与设计权衡的对比分析。

Result: 在能效、专用指令开发和框架集成方面取得进展；同时存在标准化不足、验证复杂度高和生态碎片化等突出问题。

Conclusion: 提出四个研究方向：专用神经处理扩展、自适应模块化处理器架构、安全框架以及高能效多域架构，为RISC-V成为下一代机器学习系统的基础平台提供路线图。

Abstract: The intersection of open-source processor architectures and machine learning is driving the demand for customizable, efficient, and accessible hardware. This survey examines the state of the RISC-V ISA in machine learning applications, analyzing current capabilities, challenges, and future directions based on recent research. The analysis covers academic and commercial implementations, software frameworks, and real-world applications. The RISC-V machine learning ecosystem is evaluated, from instruction set extensions and core implementations to compiler optimizations and deployment strategies. Key contributions include a unified taxonomy of RISC-V ML implementations, a comparative analysis of performance and design trade-offs, an evaluation of software toolchain maturity, and the identification of emerging trends in instruction set extensions and specialized accelerators. Findings reveal progress in energy efficiency, specialized instruction development, and framework integration, while highlighting challenges in standardization, verification complexity, and ecosystem fragmentation. The analysis proposes four research directions to address current limitations: specialized neural processing extensions, adaptive and modular processor architectures, security frameworks, and energy-efficient multi-domain architectures. These directions provide a roadmap for advancing RISC-V as a foundational platform for next-generation machine learning systems.

</details>


### [421] [Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20744)
*Haocheng Xi,Yiming Xie,Hexu Zhao,Yiwen Zhang,Michael Liu,Thomas Creavin,Kurt Keutzer,Xiuyu Li,Zhaoyang Lv,Chenfeng Xu,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Video DeltaNet（VDN），以局部 Softmax 注意力结合双向线性记忆建模长程视频上下文，并在 MiniMax H3 上实例化为 VDN-H3，实现 8 步蒸馏下 14.3 秒 768p 视频的 DiT 去噪仅需 6.70 秒，相比 50 步稠密基线提速 14.5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型在去噪过程中需反复处理长时空 token 序列，注意力成为主要计算瓶颈。线性注意力虽在近期大语言模型中被广泛采用，但直接用于视频模型时往往无法保留高质量生成所需的细粒度交互。

Method: 提出 Video DeltaNet（VDN）：将局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆相结合以建模长程视频上下文。其线性分支引入 Video Delta Attention（VDA），通过联合纳入空间 token 实现每帧更新一次记忆；两支路采用独立的输出投影与可学习门控进行校准；并通过分阶段教师对齐策略将新路径逐步引入预训练模型。在 MiniMax H3 上实例化为 VDN-H3，混合结构应用于视频-视频交互，文本与音频相关交互仍保留 Softmax；配合 8 步蒸馏与优化的 SGLang 服务栈。

Result: VDN-H3 在 8 张 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上完成 14.3 秒、768p 视频的 DiT 去噪仅需 6.70 秒，相比相同 GPU 数量下 50 步稠密 H3 基线实现 14.5 倍加速。

Conclusion: VDN 通过局部分辨率保留与线性长程建模的混合设计，有效缓解视频扩散模型注意力瓶颈，在不牺牲细粒度交互的前提下显著提升推理效率，证明了该混合线性注意力范式在视频生成中的可行性与实用性。

Abstract: Video diffusion models repeatedly process long spatiotemporal token sequences during denoising, making attention a major computational bottleneck. Linear attention offers an appealing alternative and has been widely adopted in recent large language models, but directly applying it to video models often fails to preserve the fine-grained interactions required for high-quality generation. We present Video DeltaNet (VDN), which combines local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range video context. Its linear branch introduces Video Delta Attention (VDA), which updates memory once per frame by jointly incorporating its spatial tokens. Separate output projections and learnable gates calibrate the two branches, while a staged teacher-alignment recipe progressively introduces the new pathway into pretrained models. We instantiate VDN on MiniMax H3, applying the hybrid to video-to-video interactions while retaining Softmax for interactions involving text or audio. With eight-step distillation and an optimized SGLang serving stack, VDN-H3 completes DiT denoising for a 14.3-second, 768p video in 6.70 seconds on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, corresponding to a 14.5x speedup over the 50-step dense H3 baseline on the same GPU count.

</details>


### [422] [Calibrated RF-Fingerprinting Under Interference With Heterogeneous Transmission Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20765)
*Tariq Abdul-Quddoos,Xiangfang Li,Lijun Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将射频指纹识别从单发射机场景扩展到同信道干扰场景，采用1D CNN进行多标签分类，并通过校准控制假阴性上界。基于POWDER 5G测试床的Wi-Fi、4G LTE和5G NR实测数据，方法在信道条件不同时达到73%–97%的准确率，且校准对分布外干扰具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RF指纹研究几乎只考虑同一时刻仅有一个发射机的场景，忽略了真实无线环境中普遍存在的同信道干扰（多信号在时间和频率上重叠），因而限制了其实际适用性。作者希望提升RF指纹识别在高竞争、真实无线环境中的可用性。

Method: 将同信道干扰下的RF指纹识别建模为多标签分类问题，使用1D卷积神经网络（CNN）进行识别；并对模型进行校准，从标签概率推导置信阈值，给出平均假阴性数量上界的保证，从而在不错过真实频谱政策违规方面提供置信度。

Result: 采用POWDER 5G测试床的真实数据，设备发射802.11a（Wi-Fi）、4G LTE和5G NR波形。结果显示，依据信道条件，校准后准确率最高可达97%，最低为73%；针对不同平均假阴性上界进行校准时，micro recall约为(1 − 校准假阴性率)；且校准对分布外干扰保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 所提方法在真实高竞争无线环境中展现出潜力，能够在同信道干扰下实现有效的RF指纹多标签识别，并通过校准提供可控的假阴性上界，兼顾识别性能与频谱政策违规检测的可靠性。

Abstract: Radio Frequency(RF)-Fingerprinting is a spectrum monitoring technique that identifies specific transmitters based on hardware impairments imprinted within the emitted signal. Although widely researched, studies almost exclusively consider scenarios where only one transmitter is emitting at a time, limiting real world applicability. In this work, we further the study of RF-Fingerprinting by considering co-channel interference, with multiple emitted signals interfering with each other, overlapping in time and frequency. Specifically, we formulate this problem as a multi-label classification problem and employ a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN). Furthermore, the models are calibrated such that the confidence thresholds for the label probabilities are derived, with guarantees on the upper bound on the average number of False Negatives, providing a degree of confidence in not missing a true spectrum policy violation. The proposed method is validated using real world data from the POWDER 5G testbed on devices transmitting 802.11a(Wi-Fi), 4G LTE, and 5G NR waveforms. The results show accuracy as high as 97% and as low as 73% after calibration depending on channel conditions. Also calibrating for various average false negatives upper bounds achieves micro recall scores of approximately (1 - calibrated false negatives) with the calibration robust to out-of-distribution interference, demonstrating the potential of the proposed method in a realistic high contention wireless environment

</details>


### [423] [PosteriorBench: From Point Estimates to Posterior Matching in Evaluating Generative Inverse Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20794)
*Jiachen Yao,Zi-Siang Hsu,Xi Deng,Aditi Gupta,Xin Ju,Sally M Benson,Gege Wen,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PosteriorBench，一个用于评估生成式逆问题求解器分布准确性的基准，包含四个物理逆问题、基于拒绝采样/MCMC 构建的高保真参考后验，以及五指标后验评估套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式逆问题评估主要关注能否产生单个合理重建，这对病态问题不足：同一稀疏或含噪观测可能对应多个解，方法可能点误差低但在后验刻画上出现模式坍塌、过度自信或平均不兼容解。因此需要评估求解器的分布准确性。

Method: 构建 PosteriorBench，覆盖 Darcy 流反演、Poisson 源恢复、碳捕集封存、光传输材料推断四类任务；用拒绝采样和 MCMC 等计算昂贵但成熟的方法生成高保真参考后验；配套五指标评估套件：后验均值误差、后验标准差误差、最大均值差异、切片 Wasserstein 距离、径向平均功率谱误差，分别衡量点精度、边缘不确定性、分布对齐与全局频率保真；覆盖稀疏感知、低分辨率观测、非线性正演、不同噪声水平与多峰先验，并采用统一流程进行分布匹配与不确定性量化。

Result: 实验揭示当前求解器普遍存在显著分布匹配差距；神经算子提升分辨率鲁棒性；引导权重与生成噪声是后验方差校准的关键因素。

Conclusion: PosteriorBench 将逆问题评测从单点重建质量推进到分布级后验准确性，为病态逆问题的生成式求解器提供统一、可比的诊断工具，并指出方差校准与分布匹配是未来改进重点。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly used to solve scientific inverse problems, but existing evaluations still focus primarily on whether a method can produce a single plausible reconstruction. This is insufficient for ill-posed problems, where multiple solutions may be consistent with the same sparse or noisy observations. In these settings, a method can achieve strong pointwise accuracy while still failing to capture the true posterior through mode collapse, overconfident uncertainty, or averaging incompatible solutions. We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for evaluating the distributional accuracy of generative inverse solvers. PosteriorBench evaluates four physics-based inverse problems: Darcy flow inversion, Poisson source recovery, carbon capture and storage, and light transport material inference. For each task, we construct high-fidelity reference posteriors using computationally heavy but established procedures such as rejection sampling and Markov chain Monte Carlo, enabling direct assessment of whether solvers recover the full set of solutions rather than the single best sample. We pair these references with a five-metric posterior evaluation suite: posterior-mean error, posterior-standard-deviation error, maximum mean discrepancy, sliced Wasserstein distance, and radially averaged power-spectrum error. These metrics assess pointwise accuracy, marginal uncertainty, distributional alignment, and global frequency fidelity. The benchmark spans sparse sensing, low-resolution observations, nonlinear forward models, varying noise levels, and multimodal priors, with a unified pipeline for distribution matching and uncertainty quantification. Our experiments reveal substantial distribution-matching gaps across current solvers, while showing that neural operators improve resolution robustness, and guidance weights and generation noise are key to posterior-variance calibration.

</details>


### [424] [Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20807)
*Martin Marek,Max Ryabinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出大模型强化学习训练-推理不匹配(TIM)导致的训练不稳定主要源于"漂移"偏差,提出加性的"score centering"校正项来抵消漂移,在多规模模型上优于重要性采样方法,且可与其组合使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型强化学习对训练引擎与推理引擎之间的微小差异(训练-推理不匹配,TIM)极为敏感;但完全消除TIM不现实,会严重损害rollout效率。因此需要一种在不牺牲效率的前提下稳定训练的方法,而作者认为问题的核心在于漂移——一种随每步训练不断累积的训练与推理之间的持久偏差。

Method: 作者分析了TIM下RL不稳定的机理,将其归因于漂移(训练与推理引擎之间逐步累积的偏差),并推导出一个加性的"score centering"校正项,通过抵消漂移来稳定RL。由于该校正为加性,它还能与重要性采样(importance sampling)方法组合。实验覆盖0.6B至30B参数的模型,在量化条件下与基于重要性采样的方法对比,并进行staleness实验。

Result: 在0.6B到30B参数模型上训练时,score centering单独使用即可在量化情况下匹配或超越基于重要性采样的方法,且不匹配越严重,优势越大。此外,由于校正是加性的,score centering可与重要性采样组合,其组合方法在staleness实验中优于纯重要性采样基线。

Conclusion: TIM下的RL不稳定主要源于可累积的漂移;通过加性的score centering校正可有效抵消漂移,稳定训练,并在量化条件下达到或超过重要性采样方法,且在更严重不匹配时优势更明显;该方法与重要性采样正交可组合,进一步提升了性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models is notoriously sensitive to small differences between training and inference engines, often referred to as the training-inference mismatch (TIM). However, completely eliminating TIM is impractical, as it would come at a major cost to rollout efficiency. In this paper, we show that the instability of RL under TIM is primarily caused by drift: a persistent bias between training and inference engines that accumulates with every training step. We derive an additive "score centering" correction term that stabilizes RL under TIM by canceling drift. When training models from 0.6B to 30B parameters, score centering alone matches or outperforms methods based on importance sampling under quantization, with the gap growing as the mismatch becomes more severe. Because the correction is additive, score centering also composes with importance sampling -- their composition outperforms pure importance-sampling baselines in our staleness experiments.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

### [425] [Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19244)
*Mahsa Amani,Seungeon Lee,Abhisek Dash,Asmaa El Fraihi,Yunah Jang,Elisabeth Kirsten,Qinyuan Wu,Krishna P. Gummadi,Manish Gupta,Abhilasha Ravichander,Muhammad Bilal Zafar,Soumi Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文首次对ChatGPT、Claude、Grok和DeepSeek四大对话平台的Web搜索全生命周期开展研究，结合真实用户交互（in vivo）与基于同一平台API的受控实验（in vitro），考察智能体的搜索触发决策、查询构造策略、检索结果的领域偏好以及结果到回答的转化过程。发现搜索决策因平台和模型差异显著，高频搜索未必提升回答质量，各平台搜索引擎倾向返回偏好领域的结果，且部分论断依赖未引用的检索结果，引发归因与可信性隐忧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式LLM智能体日益依赖Web搜索，但其端到端搜索生命周期仍缺乏系统理解，亟需揭示智能体在何时搜索、如何构造查询、检索到何种结果以及如何据此生成回答，以指导面向对话式检索的AI智能体与搜索工具设计。

Method: 研究覆盖四大主流对话平台（ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek），采用两类方法互补：一是真实用户交互的in vivo观察，二是通过各平台API调用同款模型进行受控的in vitro实验；据此系统分析四个环节：Web搜索调用决策的质量、查询构造策略、检索结果的潜在领域偏好，以及将搜索结果转化为有据回答时的选择行为。

Result: Web搜索决策在平台与模型间差异显著；更频繁地调用Web搜索并不必然带来更好的回答质量；对话智能体采用不同的复杂查询策略；各平台自有搜索引擎会返回其偏好领域的检索结果；回答总体以检索结果为据，但存在依赖未引用检索结果的论断，带来归因与可靠性问题。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了对话式智能体Web搜索全生命周期的典型行为与局限，对面向对话式检索优化的未来AI智能体与Web搜索工具设计具有重要启示，尤其需关注搜索调用策略的合理性、检索来源的公平性以及回答中证据引用与归因的可靠性。

Abstract: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search results they receive, and the choices they make when transforming search results into grounded responses. We find that Web-search decisions vary substantially across platforms and models, while more frequent Web-search invocation does not necessarily yield better response quality. We further show that conversational agents employ different complex querying strategies and that platform specific search engines return search results from their preferred domains. Finally, although responses are largely grounded in search results, some claims rely on uncited search results, raising concerns about attribution and reliability. Our findings have important implications for the design of future AI agents and Web search tools optimized for conversational retrieval.

</details>


### [426] [FINSKILLOPS: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for SEC Filing QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19680)
*Yanzhang Ma,Zhenghan Tai,Hanwei Wu,Sizhe Guan,Jianliang Lei,Hailin He,Chaolong Jiang,Jijun Chi,Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Bohuai Xiao,Jingrui Tian,Xinlu Wu,Xingao Zhan,Peng Lu,Muzhi Li,Yihong Wu,Liheng Ma,Sicheng Lyu,Tianshuo Yan,Junhao Zhu,Yaqian Xu,Lei Ding,Yufei Cui,Ziquan Liu,Boyu Han,Hengli Liu,Ling Zhou,Xinyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将金融问答系统的部署后改进定义为"受控行为维护"，提出FINSKILLOPS多智能体系统，通过受控技能范围、准入与生命周期管理，实现无回归的可靠自改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融QA系统通常在部署前通过改进检索、提示或智能体协调来优化，部署后可靠性行为固定不变。实践中，新的SEC文件问题反复暴露在期间、实体、证据使用和计算方面的异构错误。现有自改进方法虽能将失败转化为新行为，但对修正适用范围及可能破坏哪些原本正确答案缺乏控制。

Method: 提出FINSKILLOPS多智能体系统：从基于证据的、带类型的失败诊断中提炼可复用技能，并通过定向验证、受保护案例回归检查、阴性对照以及版本化替换或淘汰机制进行治理。

Result: 在六个金融QA基准上，单一冻结技能注册表在所评估系统中取得最高的裁决加权正确率和参考一致性；进化技能在增强基准上将正确率从3.70提升至4.55。在独立的12轮运行研究中，33个候选技能仅6个被晋升，同时监控非纠正率从20.0%降至12.5%。

Conclusion: 受控的技能范围、准入和生命周期管理是可靠自改进的基础。

Abstract: Financial QA systems are typically improved before deployment through better retrieval, prompting, or agent coordination, leaving their reliability behavior fixed thereafter. In practice, new SEC-filing questions repeatedly expose heterogeneous errors in period, entity, evidence use, and calculation. Existing self-improvement methods can turn failures into new behaviors, but offer limited control over where a correction should apply or which previously correct answers it may break. We therefore frame post-deployment improvement as controlled behavioral maintenance: recurring failures should become scoped skill patches, and each patch should earn deployment with- out introducing regressions. We instantiate this view in FINSKILLOPS, a multi-agent system for SEC filing QA. FINSKILLOPS derives reusable skills from evidence-grounded, typed failure diagnoses and governs them through targeted validation, protected-case regression checks, negative controls, and versioned replacement or retirement. Across six financial QA benchmarks, a single frozen skill registry achieves the highest verdict-weighted correctness and reference consistency among the evaluated systems. Evolved skills raise correctness from 3.70 to 4.55 on our enhanced benchmark. In a separate 12-round operational study, only six of 33 proposed skills are promoted, while the monitoring non-correct rate falls from 20.0% to 12.5%. These results establish controlled skill scope, admission, and lifecycle management as the foundation for reliable self-improvement.

</details>


### [427] [What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19182)
*Chao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究对2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv上14,767篇评估资源论文进行分阶段筛选与全文自动编码，刻画LLM基准在目标系统与领域、评估材料与条件、评分机制上的演变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究多关注模型排名的变化，却忽视了评估需求本身如何演变；基准的多样化反映了研究者对LLM能力期待与成功标准的转变，需要系统刻画。

Method: 系统采集arXiv 2022年1月至2026年8月引入或更新评估资源的14,767篇论文，采用分阶段筛选与自动化全文编码，分析目标系统与领域、评估材料与条件、评分机制三方面的变化趋势。

Result: 评估重点日益转向行动、交互与专业应用；新旧设计要素频繁并存；模型参与度发展不均衡——LLM评分在智能体与非智能体组别中均增长，而模型生成材料在近期队列中无持续增长。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了公共研究如何将能力预期转化为具体测试与成功标准；当AI参与构建测试、执行任务与评判回答时，需反思扩展评估是否带来更独立的证据，抑或复制了参与模型自身的偏好与盲点。

Abstract: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examine changes in target systems and domains, evaluation materials and conditions, and scoring mechanisms. The collection shows growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, while established and newer design elements frequently coexist. Model participation also develops unevenly: LLM-based scoring grows within both agent and non-agent groups, whereas model-generated materials show no comparable sustained increase in recent cohorts. These findings illuminate how public research translates capability expectations into concrete tests and criteria for success. As AI participates in constructing tests, performing tasks, and judging responses, they also raise a question: does expanding evaluation provide more independent evidence, or risk reproducing the preferences and blind spots of its participating models?

</details>


### [428] [Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19472)
*Alizishaan Khatri,Chiquita Prabhu,Omkar Neogi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用LLM内部激活训练轻量级探针来检测有害提示，避免外部护栏模型的高延迟与高算力开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统日益依赖LLM，但现有外部护栏模型存在延迟和算力开销大的问题，且无法洞察模型内部运作，形成"保障缺口"。作者追问：模型自身是否已知内容有害？

Method: 从LLaMA-3.1-8B提取激活值，训练轻量级MLP分类器探针（12.6M参数）来检测有害提示。

Result: 在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上，探针F1分数分别达99%、83%和84%，与规模大1000倍的护栏模型相当，同时显著降低延迟和算力成本。

Conclusion: LLM内部激活已编码有害信息，轻量探针可作为高效、低成本的内部安全检测方案，弥补外部护栏的保障缺口。

Abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.

</details>


### [429] [EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19523)
*Yinzhu Quan,Zefang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 EconSkills——一个将已验证的 EconWebArena 轨迹提炼为参数化标准操作流程（SOP）的技能库与评测框架，并验证其在经济数据网页任务中的可迁移性与检索选择效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网页智能体常重复访问相同站点，但现有评测通常丢弃此前成功交互中学到的过程性知识，导致经验无法复用。

Method: 将已验证轨迹蒸馏为参数化技能，每条技能记录适用范围、导航流程、站点特定指导、验证检查与恢复步骤，并用占位符替换源实例取值；区分两个问题：已知相关流程能否迁移到留出任务，以及从技能库中选择时智能体能否保持该收益。评测包括受控迁移实验与技能库规模下的检索实验。

Result: 受控迁移中，匹配技能优于无技能提示，并在配对成功案例上所需步骤更少；抽象化显著优于直接回放原始轨迹。技能库规模下，检索整体与无技能基线相当，在直接覆盖任务上表现最佳；按覆盖率分层显示，未覆盖任务上的近似匹配会抵消部分增益。浏览器轨迹进一步识别出流程指导可缩短门户特定导航的场景，以及仍需语义验证的场景。

Conclusion: 可复用的经济类网页操作流程能够跨任务实例迁移，为覆盖感知的选择与上下文投递提供了具体设计目标。

Abstract: Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether an agent can retain that benefit when selecting from a library. In controlled transfer, matched skills improve success over no-skill prompting and require fewer steps on paired successes, while abstraction is substantially more effective than replaying raw trajectories. At library scale, retrieval is competitive with the no-skill baseline overall and performs best on directly covered tasks; coverage-stratified outcomes show that approximate matches on uncovered tasks offset these gains. Browser trajectories further identify when procedural guidance shortens portal-specific navigation and when semantic verification remains necessary. These results establish that reusable economic web procedures can transfer across task instances and provide a concrete design target for coverage-aware selection and context delivery.

</details>


### [430] [When Hiring Becomes Agent-Mediated: Evaluating Access and Recurrence in Two-Agent Résumé Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19530)
*Jian Gao,Hang Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将简历筛选建模为雇主方与候选方两个智能体的双边证据交换过程，并与传统一次性单轮判定进行比较，发现双智能体筛选会改变通过对象集合、提高边缘样本的通过率，且其决策在重复运行中的稳定性低于共享选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 招聘本质上是双向的：雇主评估匹配度，候选人则呈现并捍卫自身资质的证据。然而作为第一道关卡的简历筛选，通常被自动化简化为对"简历—岗位"配对的静态、单次调用判断，忽略了候选方的申辩与证据补充，因此需要研究更贴近双边互动的筛选程序。

Method: 在600个构建的"简历—岗位"配对上，使用GPT-5.5与Claude Opus 4.7两种模型，对比单次调用筛选与双智能体筛选（雇主侧与候选侧智能体交换证据并更新判断后再决定谁进入下一轮）。在191对共同边缘样本池上重复运行三次，统计通过实例率、决策方向变化，并检验是否存在单一阈值能复现双智能体一致选中的申请；同时对发现阶段选中的案例在新运行中重执行，比较双智能体独有选择与共享选择的复现率，并设置单独的一次性调用后续实验作为对照。

Result: 双智能体筛选使更多申请进入下一轮：GPT-5.5由33.3%升至39.3%，Opus 4.7由34.0%升至35.5%。在191对边缘样本池的三次运行中，通过实例率分别由4.5%升至26.2%、由6.5%升至16.1%。这种变化并非单向放宽：双智能体筛选会拒绝一些单次调用通过的申请，决策在两个方向上均发生改变。在相近的通过量下，两种程序通过的是不同申请，且不存在任何单次调用阈值能稳定复现双智能体筛选所选中的申请。在新运行中重执行发现阶段选中的案例时，双智能体独有选择的复现频率低于共享选择，在GPT-5.5下差异明显、在Opus 4.7下较不确定；而单独的一次性调用后续实验未出现类似下降。

Conclusion: 当招聘在雇主与候选人两端都由智能体中介时，决定谁能进入人工复审、以及这种进入机会是否可靠复现的，不仅是背后的模型，更是筛选程序本身的设计。

Abstract: Hiring is bilateral: employers assess fit, while candidates present and defend evidence of their qualifications. Yet résumé screening, the first gate, is commonly automated as a static, one-call judgment over a résumé-job pair. We study a two-agent alternative in which employer-side and candidate-side agents represent these roles, exchange evidence, and update their judgments before deciding who advances. We compare procedures on 600 constructed résumé-job pairs using GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Two-agent screening advances more applications (33.3% to 39.3% for GPT-5.5; 34.0% to 35.5% for Opus 4.7). Across three runs on the common 191-pair borderline pool, pass-instance rates rise from 4.5% to 26.2% and from 6.5% to 16.1%, respectively. This is not a uniform relaxation: two-agent screening rejects applications one-call advances, changing decisions in both directions. At similar pass volumes, the procedures advance different applications, and no one-call threshold recovers applications consistently selected by two-agent screening. Among discovery-selected cases re-executed in fresh runs, two-agent-only selections recur less often than shared selections, clearly under GPT-5.5 and less certainly under Opus 4.7, while a separate one-call follow-up shows no comparable decline. As hiring becomes agent-mediated on both sides, the screening procedure, not only the model behind it, shapes who reaches human review and how reliably that access recurs.

</details>


### [431] [From Intent to Action: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Vehicle Voice Command Authorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19630)
*Diba Afroze,Xingli Zhang,Yazhou Tu,Xiali Hei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出202个场景的基准（含七分类参考决策），评估LLM在车载语音助手中执行前的授权决策能力，发现即使最强API模型也存在False Execute，结构化决策不能作为独立安全机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益集成到车载语音助手中，将自然语言请求映射到车辆功能形成安全攸关的授权问题。系统在执行前需在"执行、拒绝、澄清、要求确认、转人工控制、触发紧急响应、不调用工具"之间做出选择。作者认为，此前评估未在说话人角色、认证状态、车辆状态和工具可用性维度上孤立考察这一"行动前决策"。

Method: 构建含202个场景、带七分类参考决策（Reference Decisions）的基准；评估两个本地开源权重模型与三个API型LLM，采用决策对齐度（Decision Alignment）与安全专用错误指标；并对Llama 3.2 3B进行受控消融，比较结构化授权策略与仅模式（schema-only）、通用安全基线。

Result: 对齐度从Llama 3.2 3B的40.1%到Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的89.1%；API模型介于83.2%–89.1%且彼此无统计显著差异。即便这些模型在161个非执行场景中仍产生2–3次False Execute，且在确认与人工控制决策上存在持续错误。消融中结构化授权策略将Llama 3.2 3B对齐度提升至40.1%，高于schema-only与通用安全基线的28.2%–29.2%，但未能消除False Execute。

Conclusion: 结构化LLM决策作为独立安全机制并不充分；部署时需要独立的强制层（enforcement layer），在调用任何车辆功能前校验工具权限与车辆状态约束。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into vehicle voice assistants. But linking natural-language requests to vehicle functions creates a safety-critical authorization problem. Before executing a command, the system must choose whether to execute, refuse, clarify, require confirmation, defer to manual control, trigger an emergency response, or make no tool call. To our knowledge, prior evaluations do not isolate this pre-action decision across speaker role, authentication status, vehicle state, and tool availability. We introduce a 202-scenario benchmark with Reference Decisions under a seven-class taxonomy. We evaluate two local open-weight models and three API-based LLMs using Decision Alignment and safety-specific error metrics. Alignment ranges from 40.1% for Llama 3.2 3B to 89.1% for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. The API-based models score between 83.2% and 89.1%, with no statistically significant differences among them. Even these models produce two to three False Executes among 161 non-execution scenarios, and persistent errors remain in confirmation and manual-control decisions. A controlled Llama 3.2 3B ablation increases alignment to 40.1% under the structured authorization policy, versus 28.2-29.2% under schema-only and generic-safety baselines, but it does not eliminate False Executes. Structured LLM decisions are therefore insufficient as a standalone safety mechanism, and deployment requires an independent enforcement layer that verifies tool permissions and vehicle-state constraints before invoking any vehicle function.

</details>


### [432] [AutoData: Agentic Search for Pre-training Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19754)
*Yan Meng,Dhruv Srikanth,Bingchen Zhao,Zhengyao Jiang,Yuxiang Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoData 将预训练数据选择建模为对可执行选择算法的搜索问题，用 LLM agent 在程序空间上迭代优化，发现的选择算法优于人工设计流程，并能从代理模型迁移到大模型，提升 CORE 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 已能自动化模型与训练代码的工程优化，但数据（尤其是预训练数据选择）仍处于 agent 优化闭环之外；已有数据混合方法通常只在固定领域集合上优化权重，搜索空间受限，难以自动发现特征交互。

Method: 将预训练数据选择视为对逐文档特征（词法统计、类别标签、困惑度等）的启发式工程，提出 AutoData：一个直接在可执行选择算法上搜索的 agent。搜索空间包含评分、分层与随机选择规则，通过代理模型验证反馈迭代精炼算法，从而自动发现特征交互。搜索在一夜内完成。

Result: AutoData 发现的选择算法优于现有人工设计的 curation pipeline；尽管仅在小型代理模型上搜索，该配方仍能迁移到更大规模，并提升下游指标 CORE。

Conclusion: 数据工程可被视为一个 agentic machine learning 问题，从而把自主研究从模型与训练代码优化扩展到数据层面。

Abstract: LLM agents have recently shown promise in automating machine learning engineering by editing model and training code under execution feedback. Data, however, remains largely outside this agentic optimisation loop. We frame pre-training data selection as heuristic engineering over per-document features, i.e., lexical statistics, categorical labels, and perplexity. We introduce AutoData, an agent that searches directly over executable selection algorithms. Unlike prior data mixture methods that optimise weights over a fixed set of domains, AutoData searches a richer program space of scoring, stratification, and stochastic selection rules, discovering feature interactions automatically by iteratively refining algorithms with validation feedback from a proxy model. Within an overnight search, AutoData discovers a selection algorithm that outperforms existing human-designed curation pipelines. Despite being searched only on this small proxy, the discovered recipe transfers to larger scales and improves the downstream metric CORE. These results suggest that data engineering can be treated as an agentic machine learning problem, extending autonomous research from model and training-code optimization to the data.

</details>


### [433] [Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19866)
*Veronika Batzdorfer,Carlo Romano Marcello Alessandro Santagiustina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文区分了LLM标注的可重复性与构念效度，利用欧盟委员会AI法案咨询数据集发现：LLM标注高度可重复（ICC>0.99），但与问卷测量收敛有限，且分歧呈系统性群体差异和空间自相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高标注可重复性常被误认为LLM推断测量有效，但可重复性并不保证其捕捉了目标构念。作者旨在检验二者的区分，并揭示何时、何群体出现构念对应偏差。

Method: 使用欧盟委员会AI法案咨询数据，将同一利益相关方的结构化问卷回答与自由文本咨询意见相链接，计算LLM标注的组内相关系数、与问卷测量的收敛效度、跨利益相关方群体的分歧效应量（Hedges' g）、跨国空间自相关（Moran's I）以及分歧水平下问卷关切与对可解释性支持的关系。

Result: LLM标注高度可重复（ICC>0.99），但与问卷测得的同名构念收敛有限。分歧呈系统性群体差异：商业协会在文本咨询中对AI风险的关切高于问卷（g=+1.0），公共机构及若干非商业群体分歧较小或为负。分歧分数显示欧洲国家间正向空间自相关（Moran's I=0.347, p=0.036）。尽管存在分歧，问卷报告的关切在所有分歧水平上仍与对可解释性的支持强烈相关。

Conclusion: LLM标注可重复性可与构念对应性差并存。将LLM用作测量工具时，应建立区分可重复性、构念效度与沟通情境变异的验证程序。

Abstract: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.

</details>


### [434] [Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20005)
*Maxim Chupilkin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究对GPT、Claude和Gemini用112种语言就20条乌克兰战争相关陈述提问，收集67,200条回答，发现同一AI系统在不同语言下给出偏向俄罗斯或偏向乌克兰的回答比例存在差异，且这种差异与国家层面亲俄/亲乌立场相关，并在三个模型中均稳定出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们越来越多地使用AI聊天机器人获取新闻和世界事件解释，但作者关注一个此前未被充分研究的问题：当用户使用不同语言提问时，AI是否给出相同的政治性回答。作者希望检验语言是否会系统性改变AI对地缘政治议题的判断。

Method: 选取GPT、Claude和Gemini三个模型，围绕乌克兰战争设计20条陈述，要求模型在112种语言下进行评价，共获得67,200条回答；随后按国家官方语言对回答分组，并与各国民众对俄罗斯的好感度、在联合国投票中对乌克兰的支持程度以及对乌援助水平进行关联分析，同时通过移除个别陈述对进行稳健性检验。

Result: 不同语言之间亲俄与亲乌回答的比例存在差异。按国家官方语言分组后，回答模式与全球政治分歧相似：亲俄回答相对更多的语言，对应其国家民众对俄罗斯看法更正面、在联合国投票中更不支持乌克兰、对乌援助更少。该模式在三个模型中均可重现，且在移除个别陈述对后依然成立。

Conclusion: 语言本身会系统性影响AI系统对地缘政治议题的回答倾向，这提示信息战可能通过塑造训练文本而影响AI模型，进而传播地缘政治偏见；AI输出的多语言一致性及其潜在的政治偏向值得进一步关注和治理。

Abstract: People increasingly turn to AI chatbots for news and explanations of world events. But do they receive the same political answers when they ask in different languages? Here we show that the language of a question can change how the same AI systems assess the war in Ukraine. We ask GPT, Claude and Gemini to evaluate twenty statements about the war in 112 languages, collecting 67,200 responses. The balance between Russia-leaning and Ukraine-leaning responses differs across languages. When we group responses by countries' official languages, they follow a pattern resembling worldwide political divisions: relatively more Russia-leaning answers correspond to more favourable public views of Russia, less support for Ukraine in United Nations votes, and less aid to Ukraine. The broad pattern recurs across all three models and remains when individual statement pairs are removed. Our findings suggest a possible route through which information warfare may shape the text used to train AI models, which may in turn spread geopolitical biases.

</details>


### [435] [Marginal utility, matrix factorization, and the Key-Value (KV) cache: a unified information-economic framework for sovereign geo-mining inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20068)
*Caroline Gans Combe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将经济学边际效用概念与矩阵分解、Transformer键值缓存统一为同一"保留特征值超过影子价格的维度"分配规则，并在地质采矿文档抽取任务中验证：11.2M参数分层分类器5分钟单卡训练即达90.0%一级准确率，延迟2.62ms、成本可忽略；同时揭示TIES模型合并的均匀密度退化模式及其逐层校准修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者试图在经济学边际效用理论与两类机器学习构造（矩阵分解、Transformer键值缓存）之间建立理论桥梁，以统一的资源分配视角解释模型压缩与缓存淘汰；并将该框架应用于地质采矿文档的自动化结构化信息抽取，以低成本小模型替代昂贵专有API。

Method: 理论上：证明评分矩阵奇异值谱构成潜在因子的递减边际效用曲线，投影协方差算子特征值谱构成模型表征的边际效用曲线，缓存淘汰与低秩缓存压缩是内存预算约束下的效用最大化，三者归约为"保留特征值高于约束影子价格的顶部维度"。应用上：提出多轮推理协议、逐层TIES模型合并流程，以及融合抽取质量、定位漂移与能耗的选择策略（对漂移项施加条件风险价值CVaR标量化）。

Result: 11.2M参数分层分类器在单GPU约5分钟训练，973篇铀矿勘探语料留出测试集一级准确率90.0%；同语料50篇人工审计中，专有模型为92.0%，但本文模型延迟2.62ms/卡片，API约2000ms，成本可忽略。诊断发现均匀密度TIES合并在五个地理上不同区域输出逐token一致却高置信度的可复现退化模式，逐层校准密度可消除该特征。全规模抽取基准（含LoRA微调）仅为投影结果而非实测。

Conclusion: 边际效用-矩阵分解-键值缓存的理论统一为缓存压缩与低秩表示提供了统一的分配准则；小型高效分层分类器在地质采矿文档抽取上接近专有模型精度而延迟与成本大幅占优；TIES合并存在需逐层密度校准方可规避的退化风险。全规模基准与LoRA微调仍属待完成的实证扩展。

Abstract: This paper builds a theoretical bridge between the economic notion of marginal utility and two machine-learning constructs, matrix factorization and the Key--Value cache of transformer language models. The singular value spectrum of a rating matrix is shown to be a diminishing marginal utility schedule for latent factors, the eigenvalue spectrum of the projected covariance operator to be the marginal utility schedule of a model's learned representation, and cache eviction and low-rank cache compression to be instances of constrained utility maximization under a memory budget. The three collapse into a single allocation rule: retain the top dimensions whose eigenvalue exceeds the shadow price of the binding constraint. The framework is applied to the automated extraction of structured information from geo-mining documents, where it motivates a multi-pass inference protocol, a layer-wise TIES model merging procedure, and a selection policy combining extraction quality, localization drift and energy, scalarized with a Conditional Value-at-Risk term on drift. Two empirical contributions are reported. An 11.2-million-parameter hierarchical classifier, trained in about five minutes on a single GPU, reaches 90.0 per cent level-1 accuracy on a held-out test set from a 973-document uranium-exploration corpus, against 92.0 per cent for a proprietary model on a fifty-document human audit of the same corpus, at a latency of 2.62 ms per card against approximately 2,000 ms for the API and at negligible cost. A diagnostic of uniform-density TIES merging exposes a reproducible degenerate mode in which the merged model returns token-identical outputs across five geographically distinct districts while declaring high confidence; re-executing the merge under layer-wise calibrated densities removes that signature on the diagnostic sample. The full-scale extraction benchmark, including LoRA fine-tuning, is reported as projected rather than measured and remains an empirical extension of this work.

</details>


### [436] [Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20543)
*Tengfei Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过将100个Wason任务的人类讨论组与匹配的LLM智能体组进行回放对比，发现"全体一致率"严重依赖评分与参与度定义，智能体组的一致性显著高于人类组，且这种模拟共识并不反映集体准确性，智能体组是人类组结果分布的有偏估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全体一致率常被视为集体认知的指标，但其数值依赖于"参与"与"最终状态"如何被操作化定义。作者希望厘清这些定义差异对模拟群体（LLM智能体）与真实人类群体比较结果的影响，从而评估用LLM模拟人类审议结果的可靠性。

Method: 回放100个留出的人类Wason任务组，并与匹配的LLM智能体组对照：按每位参与者讨论前的回答为每个智能体播种一个"信念锚定"智能体，并用同一套代码对智能体与人类评分。进行两种盲后敏感性分析：基于提交（submit-based, n=98）的比较与参与度匹配（participation-matched, n=45）的比较；并做了去除早停、去除可记忆答案的重参数化检验。

Result: 不同人类评分定义下的一致率估计从24.0%到57.0%不等；约五分之一的人类参与者从未发帖，而智能体几乎总是发帖。智能体组在两种敏感性分析中一致性更高：基于提交比较的差距为34.0和43.9个百分点（聊天与推理模式），参与度匹配比较的差距为34.1和44.4个百分点，两种路径的差距在0.5个百分点内收敛。去除早停、去除可记忆答案后差距依然存在；推理模式组此时近乎全体一致，但大多为错误答案。模拟共识未反映集体准确性，信念锚定智能体组是人类组结果分布的有偏估计。

Conclusion: 人类与LLM智能体群体在"全体一致率"上的差距稳健存在，且受评分与参与度定义强烈影响；模拟共识不能代表集体准确性。研究提供了一个"评分显式化"的基础框架，用于评估模拟群体对人类审议结果的估计是否可信。

Abstract: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

</details>


### [437] [PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20634)
*Julian Eggert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出概率Allen代数（PAA），一种从区间边界分布出发生成关系概率的完备扩展，将13种Allen时序关系统一于同一概率空间，并实现为开源Python包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Allen区间代数用精确边界定义13种刚性谓词，无法处理来自语言、感知、数据库或不确定历史中的模糊时间信息，如"just before"或"roughly during"这类具有程度语义的表达。

Method: 采用生成式建模：时间点为高斯分布；区间由高斯中点与截断高斯时长构成。所有关系均表达为同一概率空间中的边界次序谓词：点-点关系化为误差函数，点-区间与区间-区间关系化为由线性不等式诱导的多元高斯正交象限概率。接触关系（meets、starts、finishes、equals）通过容差带获得正测度，在单一容差下13种关系构成真正划分，容差趋零时退化为经典Allen。

Result: 该构造推导出而非假定Allen分类体系：粗粒度谓词（precedence、overlap、containment）为叶节点之并，概率为叶概率之和；随区间坍缩为点，层级结构保持，13种关系缩减为5种再到3种。每种关系进一步分解为相关感知的时间原语。代数具有尺度不变性，并区分"shortly before"等程度表达与接触关系。结果经蒙特卡洛验证，并作为开源测试Python包发布。

Conclusion: PAA为不确定时序信息提供了统一、完备且尺度不变的概率化Allen代数，可自然处理模糊时间表达并兼容CIDOC CRM时间原语，兼具理论完备性与工程可用性。

Abstract: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.

</details>


### [438] [An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20804)
*Run-Ze Fan,Zihao Zhang,Simin Ma,Yebowen Hu,Shouju Wang,Kaiqiang Song,Fei Liu,Hamed Zamani,Xiaoyang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过固定执行循环、变化规划、动作空间与上下文管理三个组件，在4个模型、SWE-Bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上评估176种匹配设置，揭示各组件对自主编码智能体性能与成本的差异化影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多将编码harness视为单体系统评估，无法判断各组件单独的有效性；作者希望通过组件级对比，明确规划、动作空间、上下文管理各自的作用机制与适用条件。

Method: 构建轻量级编码harness，固定执行循环，仅变化三个组件：规划、动作空间、上下文管理。在4个模型、SWE-Bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上评估176种匹配设置，覆盖5种上下文管理策略、4种上下文窗口预算，以及针对规划与动作空间的有针对性消融实验，并进行轨迹级分析。

Result: (1) 上下文预算收紧时上下文管理价值增大，收益主要来自避免上下文溢出失败；(2) 先用规则化省略再用LLM摘要效率最佳，使省略内容可回收反而增加少被使用的机制且无精度提升；(3) 规划对弱模型是精度支架、对强模型是省钱手段，精度变化很小；(4) 预定义工具对bash能力弱的模型有帮助，bash能力强的模型仅用bash界面即可有效工作且成本显著更低。轨迹分析显示：上下文管理延长执行轨迹但不明显改变行为，规划改变轨迹停止位置，动作空间改变写代码的粒度。

Conclusion: 研究为模型与预算感知的harness设计提供依据，并给出可模块化评估未来harness组件的框架，说明组件效果高度依赖模型能力与上下文预算。

Abstract: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

</details>


### [439] [Constraint-Safe Graph-Context Scoring for Stable Point-Feature Labels Under Text-Width and Accessibility-Inspired Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19848)
*Taimoor Ahmad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LABELSENSE-Pilot是一个可复现的点要素标注放置原型：每要素生成8个罗盘方位候选，用MLP基于图上下文打分并加入前次放置奖励，经混合整数优化求解布局；在2500个机场坐标、155国数据上，5个随机种子下标签显示率85.62%、闪烁率2.09%、零碰撞，验证了几何有效性与稳定性的工程折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式地图的点要素标注需同时兼顾几何有效性、显示产出率、局部放置效用和相机运动下的稳定性；无障碍与多语言需求会改变标签尺寸，但算法评估常被简化为重叠计数，缺乏对这些维度的可审计权衡分析。

Method: 每要素生成8个罗盘候选位；用多层感知机对图上下文摘要打分（作者明确说明该打分器并非图Transformer）；打分中加入前次放置奖励；通过混合整数优化选择最终布局；对每个输出布局校验视口包含、每要素唯一性和两两间隔。实验采用2500个机场坐标与名称、覆盖155个国家，按国家分组划分，并生成密度、相机、文本后缀、偏好和放大字号等压力测试。

Result: 5个种子平均显示85.62%标签，闪烁2.09%，碰撞为零。与手工效用整数规划相比，牺牲1.43个百分点显示率，换来闪烁率下降12.04个百分点。感知放大框布局产生零代理违规，而标准几何在1.5倍放大下重评估时违规率达52.57%。

Conclusion: 结果确立的是一种可审计的工程折中，而非人类无障碍性、多语言可用性或用户偏好证据；正式投稿前仍需官方近期基线对比与参与者实证数据。

Abstract: Point-feature label placement on interactive maps must reconcile geometric validity, display yield, local placement utility, and stability across camera motion. Accessibility and multilingual requirements further change label dimensions, yet algorithmic evaluations often collapse these concerns into overlap counts. We present LABELSENSE-Pilot, a reproducible prototype that generates eight compass candidates per feature, scores candidates with a multilayer perceptron over graph-context summaries, adds a previous-placement bonus, and selects a layout through mixed-integer optimization. The executed scorer is deliberately not described as a graph transformer. Every returned layout is checked for viewport containment, per-feature uniqueness, and pairwise clearance. Experiments use 2,500 airport coordinates and names spanning 155 countries, with country-grouped splits and generated density, camera, text-suffix, preference, and enlarged-font stressors. Across five seeds, LABELSENSE-Pilot displayed 85.62 percent of labels with 2.09 percent flicker and zero collisions. Versus a handcrafted-utility integer program, LABELSENSE-Pilot sacrificed 1.43 percentage points of display while reducing flicker by 12.04 points. Enlarged-box-aware layouts produced zero proxy violations, whereas standard geometry reevaluated at 1.5x violated 52.57 percent of selected placements. These results establish an auditable engineering trade-off, not human accessibility, multilingual usability, or preference. Official recent baselines and participant evidence remain required before submission.

</details>


### [440] [JEPA-WAM: Connecting Generated Visual Instructions to World Action Models through JEPA Latent Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20277)
*Tianbin Liu,Jian Zhu,Taiyi Su,Jianjun Zhang,Chong Ma,Zitai Huang,Yi Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 JEPA-WAM，通过文本指令生成多样化视觉指令（任务完成图像），并用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码为紧凑目标 token，以交叉注意力条件化视频与动作专家，显著提升机器人指令遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在仅依赖文本指令时指令遵循能力有限。作者认为原因部分在于机器人学习数据的结构性失衡：视觉-动作轨迹丰富，但语言标注稀疏且重复，导致策略更依赖视觉上下文与动作规律来识别任务，而非真正 grounding 文本指令。

Method: 为每条文本指令配备随机生成的视觉指令库：用现成文本到图像生成器（不训练）按指令采样多张任务完成图像，作为视觉目标参考。虽在外观与布局上可能与当前场景不同，但语义上与指令对齐。用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码这些参考以聚焦任务级语义而非外观，将稠密目标表示压缩为紧凑目标 token，通过交叉注意力同时条件化视频专家与动作专家。

Result: 构建了涵盖分布内、分布外场景、分布外指令三种设置的真实机器人指令遵循基准。JEPA-WAM 在三设置下成功率分别为 87.3%、74.5%、80.9%，分别比 π0 和 Fast-WAM 高出至少 10.0、27.3、14.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过引入多样化生成式视觉目标参考并借助自监督视觉编码器提取任务级语义，JEPA-WAM 有效缓解了语言标注稀疏带来的指令 grounding 不足问题，在多种泛化设置下大幅超越现有基线。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated strong robotic manipulation capabilities by augmenting pretrained video generative models with action experts. However, current WAMs still show limited instruction-following ability when conditioned solely on text instructions. We argue that this limitation stems in part from a structural imbalance in robot-learning data: rich visual-action trajectories are often paired with sparse and repetitive language annotations, allowing policies to identify tasks from visual context and motion regularities rather than grounding the instruction itself. To address this limitation, we introduce JEPA-WAM, which augments each text instruction with a bank of stochastically generated visual instructions, providing diverse visual cues for instruction following. Specifically, JEPA-WAM uses an off-the-shelf text-to-image generator to sample multiple task-completion images conditioned on the text instruction, without training the generator. Although these generated images may differ from the current visual scene in appearance and layout, they remain semantically aligned with the instruction and serve as visual goal references. To focus on task-level semantics beyond appearance, we encode these references with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. The resulting dense goal representations are compressed into compact goal tokens that condition both the video and action experts through cross-attention. We further construct a real-robot instruction-following benchmark covering in-distribution, out-of-distribution scene, and out-of-distribution instruction settings. On this benchmark, JEPA-WAM achieves success rates of 87.3%, 74.5%, and 80.9% in these three settings, outperforming π0 and Fast-WAM by at least 10.0, 27.3, and 14.5 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [441] [Dual-Axis Policy Optimization for LLM Agents: Bayesian Feedback Attribution and Trajectory Mass Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19830)
*Yingxuan Zhuang,Binhe Yu,Jingxiao Yang,Ruopei Sun,Ziting Li,Cheng Tan,Xuhong Zhang,Jianwei Yin,Jintao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出BATON双轴策略优化框架，将LLM智能体的强化学习分解为轨迹内反馈归因与轨迹间目标聚合两个维度，分别用贝叶斯反馈归因和轨迹质量归一化两个方法实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体强化学习包含两个不同的优化维度：轨迹内如何利用环境反馈，以及批次中完整轨迹如何聚合。已有方法未将这两个维度显式区分并分别建模，因此难以独立衡量和改进各自的贡献。

Method: 将问题形式化为轨迹内反馈归因（Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution）与轨迹间目标聚合（Inter-Trajectory Objective Aggregation）两个维度。BATON在第一轴采用贝叶斯反馈归因，基于采样动作构建以反馈为条件的后验分布；在第二轴采用轨迹质量归一化（TMN），为每条完整轨迹分配相同的优化权重。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA上结合GRPO与GiGPO进行实验，结果表明两个轴各自带来独立增益，且二者结合在不同模型规模下始终取得最强的整体性能。

Conclusion: 通过将LLM智能体强化学习显式分解为轨迹内与轨迹间两个正交维度，BATON验证了两个维度的独立有效性与互补性，为策略优化提供了一个可解释的双轴框架。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for LLM agents involves two distinct optimization di- mensions: how environment feedback is exploited within a trajectory, and how complete trajectories are aggregated across a batch. We formulate these dimen- sions as Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution and Inter-Trajectory Objec- tive Aggregation, and introduce BATON (Bayesian Attribution and Trajectory Objective Normalization), a dual-axis policy optimization framework. BATON instantiates the first axis with Bayesian Feedback Attribution, which constructs a feedback-conditioned posterior over sampled actions, and the second with Trajec- tory Mass Normalization (TMN), which assigns equal optimization mass to com- plete trajectories. Experiments with GRPO and GiGPO on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA show that both axes provide independent gains and that their combi- nation consistently achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales.

</details>


### [442] [Position: It is Time to Virtualize Foundation Models with a Self-evolving Operating System Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19203)
*Suparna Bhattacharya,Tarun Kumar,Cong Xu,Satish Kumar Mopur,Jiahao Li,Ashish Mishra,Aalap Tripathy,Annmary Justine Koomthanam,Martin Foltin,Ian Foster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张为智能体化的基础模型应用引入"基础模型操作系统"（FMOS），通过虚拟化 FM 交互、统一编排记忆、模型选择、资源分配与验证策略，解决当前技术栈碎片化与治理脆弱问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 应用已从单一单体基础模型转向复合智能体系统，但现有技术栈仍高度碎片化：尽管 MCP、A2A 等协议改善了工具/智能体连接性，各框架仍内嵌隐式的运行时来处理状态、记忆、预算与护栏，导致行为不可移植、治理脆弱。这一局面类比于操作系统出现之前的计算机时代——每个程序都要重复实现基础服务。

Method: 作为立场论文，作者提出 FMOS 这一系统层构想：对外虚拟化 FM 交互，类比虚拟机抽象物理硬件，使应用获得"专用、可信、能力近乎无限"的 FM 实例幻象；对内则跨记忆层级编排知识，负责模型选择与资源分配，并执行验证与策略强制。其策略机制借鉴人脑"快直觉 / 慢审慎"的双过程切换，学习何时介入、何时直接放行推理，并基于运行经验持续自适应调整策略。

Result: 本文为立场性论述，未给出实验数据或量化结果，其核心产出是提出 FMOS 的概念框架、分层职责划分（虚拟化层、记忆编排、模型选择与资源分配、验证与策略执行）及其与现有碎片化技术栈的对比论证。

Conclusion: 作者认为，领域亟需一个类操作系统的系统层（FMOS），将基础模型交互虚拟化并统一治理，使智能体系统的行为可移植、治理可靠，同时具备自适应干预能力，从而推动 AI 应用从"前操作系统"阶段走向系统化阶段。

Abstract: AI applications have shifted from single, monolithic foundation models (FM) to compound agentic systems. Yet today's stacks remain fragmented: even as protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) ease tool/agent connectivity, each framework embeds an implicit runtime for state, memory, budgets, and guardrails, making behavior non-portable and governance brittle. It mirrors computing before operating systems, when every program re-implemented basic services. This position paper argues that the field now needs a Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) -- a system layer that virtualizes FM interactions analogous to how virtual machines abstract physical hardware, giving applications the illusion of dedicated, trustworthy FM instances with effectively unbounded capabilities. Internally, the FMOS orchestrates knowledge across memory tiers, model selection and resource allocation, and verification and policy enforcement. Like the human brain switching between fast intuition and slow deliberation, the FMOS learns when to intervene and when to let inference proceed directly and continuously adapting its policies based on operational experience.

</details>


### [443] [Compositional Reasoning in Language Models under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19465)
*Yu He,Yingxi Li,Yifei Wang,Ellen Vitercik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出依赖图框架形式化组合推理，划分三个递进复杂度层级，并借助数据结构任务实证发现"分解到组合"的不对称性：分解技能训练难以迁移至组合任务，而组合任务训练更易反向迁移到分解任务，并给出理论解释与多维度泛化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合推理是现实问题求解的核心能力：训练数据天然有限，模型必须通过以新方式组合已学技能来实现泛化。尽管RL等后训练方法显著提升了语言模型的推理能力，但其对组合推理的影响尚不清晰，亟需形式化框架与实证证据。

Method: 提出依赖图（dependency-graph）框架来形式化组合推理，定义三个复杂度递增的组合性层级；在实证上以数据结构任务作为实例化载体（具备确定性奖励计算与清晰的组合结构）；在该设定下开展训练与评估，并针对长度外推、结构分布偏移、以及向需未见技能任务的迁移进行组合泛化评测；最后在真实工具调用基准上开展试点研究。

Result: 一致地观察到"分解—组合"不对称性：分解技能训练不能可靠迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更易反向迁移到分解任务；论文为该不对称性提供了理论解释；在长度外推、结构分布偏移与未见技能迁移等设定下评估了组合泛化表现；工具调用基准的试点研究给出了该不对称性可能延伸至实际场景的初步证据。

Conclusion: 组合推理可由依赖图框架分层刻画；分解与组合技能间的迁移存在方向性不对称，且该现象在受控数据结构任务与初步的真实工具调用场景中均有体现，提示后训练策略设计需重视组合结构的方向性差异。

Abstract: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we instantiate this framework with data-structure tasks, which provide deterministic reward computation and clear compositional structure. We find a consistent decomposed-to-composed asymmetry: decomposed-skill training does not reliably transfer to composed tasks, whereas composed-task training transfers more readily back to decomposed tasks. We provide theoretical explanation for this asymmetry, and further evaluate compositional generalization under length extrapolation, structural distribution shift, and transfer to tasks requiring unseen skills. Finally, we present a pilot study on real-world tool-calling benchmarks, showing preliminary evidence that the decomposed-to-composed asymmetry can extend to practical settings.

</details>


### [444] [QVAC Genesis III: A Large-Scale, High-Quality Open Synthetic STEM Corpus for Efficient Language Model Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19513)
*Davide Vitabile,N. Ranjan,Akshay Nambiar,Kamal K. Gupta,Amril Nazir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出QVAC Genesis III，一个1914.3亿token、覆盖19个STEM领域的多领域合成语料，采用"以弱端侧学生模型失败/成功为信号"的双重生成策略，并通过1.7B参数从零训练实验验证其优于Cosmopedia-v2与Cosmo-1B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向边缘AI与端侧部署的STEM语言模型受限于token预算，而开放生态缺乏高"每token学习价值"的STEM合成数据集，大机构私有语料难以复用，小模型训练数据供给不足。

Method: 构建191.43B token、跨19个STEM领域、多难度与多教学风格的合成语料；采用双重生成策略：以弱端侧学生模型的失败样本转化为纠正性解释，将其成功样本扩展为覆盖所有选项的对比式选项级推理；并提出LLM-as-a-parser评测协议，从自由文本输出中抽取最终答案，同时统计准确率与答案有效性。

Result: 在1.7B参数从零训练的受控消融中，使用QVAC Genesis III训练的模型在ARC、GPQA Diamond、MMLU STEM上一致优于Cosmopedia-v2训练的模型及公开的Cosmo-1B，ARC-E最高提升+28.57%、ARC-C最高提升+21.35%，有效答案率最高达99.45%。

Conclusion: QVAC Genesis III证明通过以弱学生模型为信号进行定向蒸馏可实现高每token效率的STEM合成预训练，为端侧小模型提供可行的开放数据方案，并配套更稳健的评测协议。

Abstract: High-quality pre-training data is a critical bottleneck for educational and STEM-specific language models targeting edge AI and on-device deployment where token budgets are tightly constrained. While major organizations train ever-larger models on private corpora, the open ecosystem lacks STEM-focused synthetic datasets that deliver high per-token learning value efficiently for small models. To address this gap, we introduce QVAC Genesis III, a 191.43B-token, STEM-focused multi-domain synthetic corpus covering 19 domains across several difficulty levels and different educational styles. QVAC Genesis III is built via a dual generation strategy that performs targeted teacher distillation using a weak edge-scale student model as signal: the student's failures are converted into corrective explanations, while its successes are expanded into contrastive option-level reasoning over all answer choices. We further introduce an LLM-as-a-parser evaluation protocol that extracts final answers from free-form outputs and tracks both accuracy and answer validity. To validate the effectiveness of our QVAC Genesis III data, we conduct controlled from-scratch ablations with 1.7B-parameter models, showing that models trained with QVAC Genesis III consistently outperform both models trained with the open-source synthetic corpus Cosmopedia-v2 and the publicly released Cosmo-1B model across ARC, GPQA Diamond, and MMLU STEM benchmarks, achieving up to +28.57% on ARC-E and +21.35% on ARC-C, while reaching a Valid Answer Rate of up to 99.45%.

</details>


### [445] [LLM-as-an-Improver: Turning Verification into Better Candidates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19515)
*Akiyoshi Tomihari,Yuma Ichikawa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Verify–Repair–Reselect (VRR) 框架，把验证反馈从单纯的排序信号扩展为候选解生成信号，通过修复优胜者与次优者并引入新思路解来扩增候选集，再按原始标准重选，从而在多个模型与基准上超越固定候选池的验证选择方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于验证器的选择方法仅将验证用于对固定候选池排序，一旦评估完成即丢弃验证反馈，未利用反馈改进候选集本身。本文探究验证能否同时优化候选解集合。

Method: 提出 LLM-as-an-Improver 与 VRR 框架：保留初始优胜者，条件性生成三个互补候选——优胜者修复版、次优者修复版、以及基于新方法的解；仅用推理时信息过滤无效与重复候选；最后在原始评价标准下重选最终答案。

Result: 在多种模型及代码生成与推理基准上，VRR 在多数设置下优于固定候选池的验证选择方法，并能在初始候选池全部错误时恢复出正确解。

Conclusion: 验证反馈不仅能从已有解中选择，还能构建超出初始候选池的更强解，表明 LLM 作为“改进者”具有更广泛的角色。

Abstract: Verifier-based selection improves LLM performance by generating multiple candidate solutions and using a verifier to select the most promising one. However, existing methods typically treat verification only as a ranking step and discard its feedback once a fixed candidate pool has been evaluated. In this paper, we ask whether verification can also improve the candidate set itself. To this end, we introduce LLM-as-an-Improver and propose Verify--Repair--Reselect (VRR), which uses verification feedback to generate and reselect improved candidates. VRR retains the initial winner while conditionally generating three complementary alternatives: repaired versions of the winner and runner-up, and a solution based on a new approach. It filters invalid and duplicate candidates using only inference-time information and then reselects the final answer under the original evaluation criteria. Across diverse models and code-generation and reasoning benchmarks, VRR improves over fixed-pool verifier-based selection in many settings and can recover correct solutions even when all candidates in the initial pool are incorrect. These results highlight a broader role for LLMs as improvers: verification feedback can not only select among existing solutions but also construct stronger candidates beyond the initial pool.

</details>


### [446] [An Architecture for Long-Horizon Agents: Levels, Ticks and Cascaded Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19519)
*Erik Nijkamp,Anurag Koul,Egor Pakhomov,Bo Pang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文主张长时程智能体必须先实现"持续运行而不遗忘"才能实现持续学习，而这种能力来自模型外部的harness。作者提出三层级架构（时间尺度分层的有界文件摘要、clocked tick、级联智能），并用十天实验验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体被要求承担跨越数天乃至数周的任务（如运维修复、研究计划），这类任务超出了任何上下文窗口、任何进程以及人类可保持关注的间隔。因此需要一种在持续学习之前先具备的"持续运行且不遗忘"的能力，且该能力不在模型本身而在其外围harness中。

Method: 1) 从长时程设定中推导出七个瓶颈；2) 提出三部分层级架构：(i) 按时间尺度划分的层级，每层保存一份概括下层的bounded file；(ii) 以clocked tick作为自主动作单元；(iii) cascaded intelligence，仅在review失败后将工作升级给更强的模型；3) 开展为期十天、人类每天仅介入一次的campaign，用该架构的智能体复现一项已发表的强化学习结果。

Result: (1) 智能体在campaign的每次上下文重置和session边界上都保持了任务线索；(2) 早期写入的操作性知识改变了后续行为，且模型权重未发生任何改变；(3) 明确了学习组件在该系统中可以进入的位置。

Conclusion: 这些经验表明，此类智能体的持续学习需要一种比任何上下文和进程都更长久的substrate，而harness已经运行的检查环节正是学习器应当归属之处。

Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out work spanning days or weeks, such as an operations remediation or a research programme. Such a task outlives any context window, any process and any interval at which a person can attend. In this paper, we argue that a long-horizon agent must run continually without forgetting before it can learn continually. This ability lies in the harness around the model rather than in the model itself. We derive seven bottlenecks from the long-horizon setting and answer them with a hierarchical architecture of three parts: (i) levels indexed by time scale, each keeping a bounded file summarising the level below; (ii) a clocked tick as the unit of autonomous action; and (iii) cascaded intelligence, where work is escalated to a more capable model only after failing review. We report on a ten-day campaign in which an agent built on this architecture reproduced a published reinforcement-learning result with a human attending once a day, and show (1) the agent kept the thread across every context reset and session boundary of the campaign, (2) operating knowledge written early changed later behaviour with no change to model weights, and (3) where learned components would enter such a system. Overall, our experience suggests continual learning for these agents needs a substrate outliving every context and process, and the checks the harness already runs are where a learner belongs.

</details>


### [447] [Self Improvement via Fast Tree-search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19526)
*Xinghong Fu,Aravinth Kulanthaivelu,Yutaro Yamada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SIFT框架，通过LLM裁判信号与解耦树搜索降低自改进编码代理的评估开销，在Polyglot基准上以更低资源取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理可通过递归修改自身实现形成自我改进循环，但现有方法成本高、计算密集。主要瓶颈在于评估候选自我修改：需用修改后的代理重跑部分基准任务，耗时长。

Method: SIFT（Recursive Self Improvement via Fast Tree-search）：用LLM-as-a-judge对候选补丁进行成对比较，胜负数用正则化Bradley-Terry模型聚合，得到强度分数用于轻量解耦树搜索中基于排名的父节点采样；同时将昂贵的下游任务评估仅保留给最有前景的节点，并采用完全解耦的树搜索流水线。

Result: 在完整Polyglot基准上，SIFT优于现有基于树搜索的自进化框架，且在CPU小时、墙钟时间与API成本方面的资源需求显著更低。

Conclusion: 以LLM裁判信号作为中间指导可避免探索被慢速评估阻塞，实现了预算受限下简单且样本高效的编码代理自我改进。

Abstract: Coding agents can recursively modify their own implementations, forming a loop of self-improvement. While prior work shows this can boost performance on coding benchmarks, existing approaches are costly and compute-intensive. We introduce a simple, sample-efficient self-improvement framework that significantly improves coding performance under strict budget constraints. We identify evaluation of candidate self-modifications as the main runtime bottleneck since prior approaches estimate their effectiveness by re-running a subset of benchmark tasks with the modified agent, which is time-consuming. We introduce Recursive Self Improvement via Fast Tree-search (SIFT), which augments these downstream task evaluations with an LLM-as-a-judge signal that performs pairwise comparisons between candidate patches, where the win-loss record is aggregated with a regularized Bradley-Terry model, and the resulting strength scores drive rank-based parent sampling inside a lightweight disaggregated tree search. Expensive downstream task evaluations are reserved only for the most promising nodes. Using a fully disaggregated tree search pipeline, the judge scores provide intermediate signal to guide exploration on promising candidate patches without being bottlenecked by slow evaluation runs. SIFT outperforms existing tree-search based self-evolution frameworks on the full Polyglot benchmark with significantly lower resource requirements in terms of CPU hours, wall clock time, and API cost.

</details>


### [448] [When2Think: Learning Difficulty-Aware Length Control for Efficient Hybrid Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19671)
*Jaejun Shim,HyunJin Kim,Young Jin Kim,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出When2Think后训练框架，将高效推理建模为实例自适应计算分配问题，通过难度感知奖励塑形实现难易问题的差异化思考深度，在数学基准上取得精度与效率的双赢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）存在系统性低效：对简单问题过度思考（overthink），对困难问题思考不足（underthink）。现有方法依赖统一长度惩罚或刚性路由，会产生"效率税"——在简单实例上节省计算却牺牲了困难实例的准确率。因此需要一种按问题难度动态分配计算的机制。

Method: 提出When2Think后训练框架。核心是实例级难度感知控制（IDAC）：一种奖励塑形机制，利用预计算的参考统计量（准确率与token用量）来调节推理深度。结合基于验证器的奖励与批次标准化优势（batch-wise standardized advantages），实现无需学习奖励模型、无需在线参考模型查询的稳定无critic优化。该方法鼓励简单实例直接作答，同时保留困难实例的扩展推理，从而学习何时使用System 1（NoThink）与System 2（Think）。

Result: 在数学基准上改善了准确率-效率权衡：相较基座模型，AIME24上Pass@3提升10.0%且token用量减少27.9%；AIME25上达到40.0% Pass@3，优于压缩与仅路由类基线。

Conclusion: 将高效推理形式化为实例级计算分配问题并采用难度感知奖励塑形，可在不牺牲困难问题性能的前提下提升效率，验证了自适应混合推理（System 1/System 2切换）的有效性。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks but exhibit systematic inefficiency: they often overthink easy problems and underthink hard ones. Existing approaches based on uniform length penalties or rigid routing incur an efficiency tax, trading reduced computation on easy instances for accuracy loss on hard instances. We formulate efficient reasoning as an instance-adaptive computation allocation problem and propose When2Think, a post-training framework for hybrid reasoning that dynamically allocates computation based on problem difficulty. Our method introduces Instance-level Difficulty-Aware Control (IDAC), a reward-shaping mechanism that leverages pre-computed reference statistics (accuracy and token usage) to regulate reasoning depth. Combined with verifier-based rewards and batch-wise standardized advantages, IDAC enables stable critic-free optimization without learned reward models or online reference-model queries. When2Think encourages direct answering on easy instances while preserving extended reasoning on hard instances, thereby learning when to use System 1 (NoThink) versus System 2 (Think). Experiments on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: on AIME24, Pass@3 increases by 10.0% while token usage is reduced by 27.9% relative to the base model, and on AIME25, When2Think achieves 40.0% Pass@3, outperforming compression and routing-only baselines.

</details>


### [449] [TorchCraft: Unified binder design by inverting an all-atom structure predictor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19770)
*TorchCraft Team,Yu Liu,Zhouhanyu Shen,Zhengyi Li,Xikun Huang,Jiaqi Liu,Shuxian Gao,Qilin Yu,Xiayan Qin,Yucheng Zhang,Mingchen Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TorchCraft是一个统一binder设计框架，通过冻结的全原子结构预测器优化序列logits，整合置信度、接触、几何和序列先验目标，在minibinder、VHH、环肽和配体结合蛋白等格式上实现设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全原子结构预测器能建模多样化分子相互作用，但将其学到的结构先验用于binder设计仍具挑战性，缺乏跨格式、跨分子情境的统一复用框架。

Method: 提出TorchCraft，在TorchFold中实现，通过冻结的全原子预测器（使用预训练AlphaFold 3权重）优化序列logits，在共享优化过程中结合置信度、接触、几何和序列先验目标，支持minibinder、框架条件化VHH、环肽和配体结合蛋白设计。

Result: 使用预训练AlphaFold 3权重生成代表性minibinder和VHH，在每种格式的四个靶点上获得实验测得的结合，且无需事后序列重设计；计算基准进一步证明框架适用于环肽和配体条件化口袋设计。

Conclusion: TorchCraft将预测器反演扩展到多种binder格式和分子情境，为复用全原子结构先验于设计提供了通用框架。

Abstract: All-atom structure predictors model diverse molecular interactions, but using their learned structural priors for binder design remains challenging. Here we present TorchCraft, a unified binder-design framework that optimizes sequence logits through a frozen all-atom predictor. Implemented in TorchFold, TorchCraft combines confidence, contact, geometric, and sequence-prior objectives within a shared optimization procedure for minibinders, framework-conditioned VHHs, cyclic peptides, and ligand-binding proteins. Using pretrained AlphaFold 3 weights, TorchCraft generated representative minibinders and VHHs with experimentally measured binding across four targets in each format, without post hoc sequence redesign. Computational benchmarks further demonstrated the framework's applicability to cyclic peptides and ligand-conditioned pocket design. TorchCraft extends predictor inversion to multiple binder formats and molecular contexts, providing a common framework for reusing all-atom structural priors in design.

</details>


### [450] [Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19820)
*Luis Leal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 正则化自我博弈中，将参考策略锚定在目标均衡点并精化，可有意选中该均衡（平均坐标误差0.007），KL锚可充当均衡选择旋钮。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在具有价值等价均衡多面体的两人零和博弈中，正则化自我博弈的均匀参考会隐式选出最大熵均衡，作者探究参考策略能否被有意用来选择指定均衡，并检验该机制何时失效。

Method: 在五个可精确求解博弈加一个二维多面体上，使用精确最佳响应与跨独立种子的等价性检验；将参考锚定于目标均衡成员并精化，配合预注册的镜像步规则，与其他参考、初始化、表格与MLP引导映射及匹配对照臂进行比较。

Result: 锚定并精化可将自我博弈导向目标成员：平均坐标误差0.007，中位可利用度5×10^-5，TOST检验在±0.05内等价；选择服从可达加权I投影（斜率0.969 [0.950, 0.987]）。失效情形：固定离流形参考代价0.08-0.25可利用度；刚性或平坦族需更小镜像步（由预注册规则设定）；边界目标欠射；曲率预测边界饱和（秩相关0.90，p=0.037），内部精度与曲率无关。表格与MLP引导映射在±0.03内等价（30种子）；对照臂显示注意力稳健特征是过量种子方差，系统位移≤0.018且不显著。对最佳响应时选择-鲁棒性权衡退化，引导仅对固定非均衡对手有意义。

Conclusion: 锚定参考于所需成员再精化的方案，把RLHF式强化学习中的KL锚重新解释为均衡选择旋钮，而非仅稳定性约束；但该引导只在对抗固定非均衡对手时有效。

Abstract: Regularized self-play -- the family behind DeepNash's Stratego play -- drives a two-player zero-sum policy to a Nash equilibrium by best-responding to a slowly moving, entropy-regularized reference policy $ρ$. When the game has a polytope of value-equivalent equilibria, the regularizer silently breaks the tie: with a uniform reference it selects the maximum-entropy member, the I-projection of $ρ$ onto the Nash set. Can the reference be used to choose the equilibrium on purpose? On five exactly solvable games plus a 2-D polytope, with exact best responses and equivalence tests over independent seeds, anchoring the reference at a target member and refining steers self-play to that member with mean coordinate error 0.007 at median exploitability $5\times10^{-5}$, TOST-equivalent to the request within $\pm0.05$; the anchoring persists through refinement and follows the reference, not the initialization. Selection follows the reach-weighted I-projection (slope 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]). We report with equal emphasis where the story breaks: fixed off-manifold references cost 0.08-0.25 exploitability; stiff or flat families require a smaller mirror step, set by a pre-registered rule; boundary targets undershoot; curvature predicts where boundary saturation bites (rank correlation 0.90, p=0.037) while interior precision is curvature-independent. Table and MLP steering maps are equivalent within $\pm0.03$ at every target (30 seeds); matched control arms show attention's robust signature is excess seed variance, any systematic shift bounded at 0.018 and not significant. Against a best response the selection-robustness trade-off is degenerate: steering matters only against fixed, non-equilibrium opponents. The recipe -- anchor the reference at the desired member and refine -- reinterprets the KL anchor of RLHF-style RL as a selection knob, not only a stability leash.

</details>


### [451] [From "Who Is This User?" to "What Does This Purchase Mean?": A Deployed Pipeline for Semantic User Profiling at Bank Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19928)
*Ryota Mitsuhashi,Tetsuro Morimura,Hirotake Ito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将属性推断从"按用户"重构为"按交易模式"，通过 Resolve/Profile/Tag 三阶段流水线，用单次 LLM 调用处理每个频繁模式，使推理预算随模式数而非用户数增长，在公开数据集上精度可比逐用户方案，并已在大型银行部署实现约三个数量级的推理量下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 按用户对交易历史进行 LLM 推理会使推理预算随用户数线性增长，在应用规模下成本不可接受。因此需要一种降低推理目标数量的方法，同时尽量保持属性推断的准确性。

Method: 提出三段式流水线：Resolve 阶段对物品名称进行抽象归并，并可选引入网络检索作为依据；Profile 阶段对每个频繁模式做一次 LLM 调用，输出预定义类别标签、自由文本属性以及各属性的流行度估计；Tag 阶段将自由文本属性聚类为可查询的数据库。核心在于推理对象由用户改为交易模式，预算随模式数量而非用户数量扩展。

Result: 在公开的 Open e-commerce 语料上，所构建数据库与直接读取每个用户原始历史的 LLM 在各项属性 AUC 上统计不可区分；流行度估计对正负用户具有判别信号。该流水线已在一家大型日本银行部署，对约数千万用户进行画像，与逐用户流水线相比 LLM 推理目标数减少近三个数量级。代码已公开。

Conclusion: 将属性推断粒度从用户转移到交易模式，可在保持与逐用户 LLM 相当推断质量的同时大幅压缩推理预算，验证了该方案在工业级大规模用户画像场景中的可行性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Per-user LLM inference on transaction histories binds the inference budget linearly to user count, which becomes prohibitive at applied scale. We re-cast attribute inference from per-user to per-transaction-pattern. The pipeline runs in three phases: Resolve abstracts item names with optional web grounding, Profile infers attributes for each frequent pattern, and Tag clusters free-text attributes into a queryable database. In Profile, a single LLM call per pattern emits predefined categorical labels, free-text attributes, and per-attribute prevalence estimates. Because inference runs over patterns rather than users, the budget grows with the pattern count rather than the user count. On the public Open e-commerce corpus, the database is statistically indistinguishable from an LLM that reads each user's raw history directly in AUC across the evaluated attributes, and the prevalence estimates carry discriminative signal between positive and negative users. The pipeline is deployed at a major Japanese bank profiling on the order of tens of millions of users, with close to a three-order-of-magnitude reduction in LLM inference targets versus a per-user pipeline. The code is publicly available on https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/profiling-agent-open-ecommerce.

</details>


### [452] [PaGNet: A Panel-Aware GBDT--Neural Network for Multi-Target Corporate Tax Avoidance Proxy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20177)
*Wonho Song,Hyungjoon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PaGNet，一个融合LightGBM与Panel-MLP的双分支混合模型，在韩国上市公司面板数据上预测企业避税代理变量，兼顾预测性能与分支依赖的可解释诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业避税代理变量的预测具有挑战性：预测信号分散于较短的企业历史与相关目标之间，而筛查导向的应用又要求模型行为透明。现有表格学习模型难以同时满足面板结构建模与可解释性需求。

Method: PaGNet采用双分支结构：一支为使用面板-时序摘要特征的LightGBM分支，另一支为采用注意力池化时序聚合与共享主干多任务学习的Panel-MLP分支。通过逐目标、验证集最优的混合器生成最终预测，并输出紧凑的分支依赖诊断，且融合过程不含可训练参数。在无泄漏的共享超参协议下于KoTeP面板（2011–2024年1,754家韩国上市公司）的四种特征机制中进行评估。

Result: 在FS1（排除直接代理滞后）与FS2（加入税务历史）机制中，应计类目标（TSTA、TSDA）稳定路由至LightGBM分支，主划分上相较六种基线中最强者解释方差提升约0.08–0.11。GETR倾向神经分支，CETR则暴露验证-测试分支选择不一致而非稳定分配。面板展平对照表明，应计收益主要来自已观测的多年度基面板数值，面板感知表示仅带来较小但方向一致的改进。滚动起点分析确认应计路由稳定，将ETR诊断限定为分划分特定行为，并识别出监督模型不及朴素持久性的远期划分。
